tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad+mor spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang*// rdo rje mi phyed gsum sbyor ba// gsang ba 'dus pa bde chen por// phyag 'tshal nas ni 'dis 'dul ba'i// skye bo skal ba can don du// dbang bskur ba yi cho ga'i rim// lung dang man ngag las rtogs nas// shin tu gsal bar bdag gis bshad// phyi rol nyid dang nang dang ni// rgyu dang 'bras bu bsre ba dang*// sku bzhi'i sa bon gdab pa'i phyir// rgyud kun las ni dbang rab bsngags// 'thor phyir dri ma sbyor ba'i phyir// lam la dbang phyir dngos grub kyi// skal ba ster phyir mchog gi ni// go 'phang nyid la 'jog phyir dbang*// lam la sbyor bar byed pa dang*// kun nas goms par byed pa dang*// mi 'phrogs pa la sbyor ba ste// dbang bskur rnam pa gsum du bshad// go rim kun nas nges pa'i phyir// snga ma med par phyi ma min// de bas dbang bskur med par lam// sgrub pa lung las rnam par smad// sngags dang rgyud dang man ngag 'dzin// cho ga'i las la rab tu mkhas// snying rjes slob ma rjes 'dzin pa// dbang bskur ba yi slob dpon mchog /dad dang snying rjes sems rab dul// rnam rtog chung zhing blo dang ldan// sngags kyi lam gyi mchog don gnyer// mthun zhing grangs dang ldan pa gzung*// sbyor ba dang ni dngos gzhi dang*// de bzhin rjes kyi bya ba ste// cho ga'i yan lag phun tshogs pa'i// dbang bskur ba yis 'bras rab ster// gsol dang bsnyen pa'i las dang ni// sa gzhi yongs su gzung ba dang*// lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga ste// sbyor ba'i yan lag rnam pa bzhi// de la thog mar slob ma dad pa dang ldan pas bla ma la yan lag lngas phyag byas te/

maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro ba'i me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar la/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyong ba// de ring bshad pa'i rin chen gyis// gtso bo bdag la bka' drin skyobs// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pa dang*/ bla mas khyod kyi bsam pa dag pas yo byad thams cad phun sum tshogs par gyis shig dang*/ kho bos kyang ji ltar nus pas rjes su gzung bar bya'o// zhes brjod par bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba la 'jug par dbang zhing bar du gcod pa thams cad las rgyal ba dang*/ slob ma'i rgyud byin gyis rlob pa la nus pa dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ sngon du bsnyen pa'i las brtsam par bya'o// 'di'ang bum pa la brten pa'i phyogs ni/ 'chad par 'gyur ba'i bum pa sta gon du gnas pa dang 'dra zhing*/ ma brten pa'i phyogs ni sgrub pa'i thabs nas 'byung ba dang mthun la/ ji srid du mtshan ma mthong ba de srid du bzla ba'am/ yang na gtso bo la 'bum phrag gcig dang*/ 'khor rnams la khri phrag re bzla'o// bsnyen pa'o// sa gzhi brtag dang bslang ba dang*// sbyang dang byin gyis brlab pa dang*// yongs su gzung dang bsrung ba ste// sa yi cho ga rnam pa drug /de la brtag pa ni dbyibs zlum po dang gru bzhi shar dang byang du gzhol ba/ kha dog dkar zhing snum pa rdo rje dang*/ nor bu dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ dga' ba 'khyil pa la sogs pa'i mtshan mas brgyan zhing*/ me tog dang 'bras bus spud pa'i ljon shing gis rnam par bkra ba/ chu klung g.yas su 'khyil pas yongs su bskor ba/ dben zhing nyams dga' la yo byad phun sum tshogs shing mi dang mi ma yin pa'i 'tshe ba dang bral ba'i sa phyogs rang gi yid 'jug pa dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su shes nas/ rmi lam gyi ltas brtag pa'i phyir/ sa phyogs de nyid du khru gang pa'i maṇ+ḍal ba las byung ba lngas legs par byugs la/ dbus su dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i me tog tshom bu sum cu so gcig dang*/

khor yug tu phyogs skyong bcu'i mtshan ma me tog tshom bu bcu dgod/ gtor ma gnyis dang mchod pa bshams te/ bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas dbus kyi me tog gi tshom bu rnams/ dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par lhag par dmigs la/ ye shes pa dang gnyis su med par byas nas/ byin gyis brlabs la dbang bskur te/ mchod pa dang gtor mas mnyes par byas nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas 'di skad ces/ dgongs shig dus gsum mgon po rnams// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa dang*// slob ma rnams la phan don du// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa yi// dkyil 'khor dam pa bri bar bgyi// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis// bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ phyi rol gyi tshom bu bcu po phyogs skyong bcur dmigs te/ so so'i ming gi mthar/ ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes pa'i sngags dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ phyag rgyas rang bzhin du gnas pa dang gnyis su med par byas la/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i gtor ma bstabs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ in+d+rā ya swā hā/ oṃ ya mā ya swā hā/ oṃ ba ru ṇā ya swā hā/ oṃ ku be rā ya swā hā/ oṃ ag+nā ya swā hā/ oṃ nair ṛ t+ya rāk+ṣa sa a dhi pa tā ya swā hā/ oṃ bā ya be swā hā/ oṃ ī sha nā ya swā hā/ tsan+d+rā yā di t+yai swā hā/ oṃ pṛ th+wī de w+yai swā hā/ zhes pa a kā ro dang bcas pa lan gsum gyis dbul lo// slar yang mchod nas/ khams gsum bzhugs pa'i lha dang klu// gnod sbyin dri za lha ma yin// gang dag rdzu 'phrul cher ldan rnams// rdo rje spyan dang snyan mnga' dang*// sa la gnas pa'i 'byung po kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa dang*// sems can rnams la phan don du// sa phyogs dge gnas 'di nyid du// dam pa'i dkyil 'khor chen 'byung ba// ji ltar bsam pa'i las byed na// khyed kyis bar chad ma byed par// dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod// de ltar khyed la bdag gis ni// bzod par gsol gyis mi bslu bar// rmi lam la sogs mtshan ma rnams// legs nyes ltas rnams bstan du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/

maṇ+ḍal de nyid la mgo bstan te/ gzhogs g.yas pa 'og tu bcug la rnam par rtog pa gzhan gyis ma g.yengs par gnyid log go /rmi lam dge ba mthong na de nyid du btsal zhing*/ gal te mi dge ba mthong na gzhan du btsal lo// bya bar 'os kyang bgegs dang bcas par rig na/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba'am/ ma grub na las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chus bgegs zhi bar byas nas/ maṇ+ḍal gyi lha la bzod par gsol te gshegs su gsol lo// sa brtag pa'o// //de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi gzhir 'os pa'i sa phyogs de bslang ba'i phyir/ sngon du yul gyi bdag po'i mi las bslangs nas/ mi ma yin pa las bslang ba'i don du/ mchod pa dang gtor ma gsum bshams la/ bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas/ dang po sa'i lha mo sta gon gyi skabs bzhin mchod cing*/ sa'i lha mo la bslang ngo*// gnyis pa gong du bstan pa'i tshul gyis phyogs skyong ba rnams la byin la/ dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod cig ces pa'i bar gyis phrin las gzhol lo// gsum pa a kā ro'i sngags kyis gzhi'i bdag po la byin nas/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag gis sems can thams cad la phan gdags pa'i phyir dang*/ slob ma rnams rjes su gzung ba'i don du gnas 'dir dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs nas/ dbang bskur ba'i las brtsam gyi/ gnas kyi bdag po thams cad kyis sa'i phyogs 'di bsam pa dag pas bdag la sbyin par gyis shig ces pas bslangs la/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ zhes pa nas/ dge ba'i grogs po nyid du gyis/ zhes pa'i bar gyis las bcol nas// dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i// lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /nga ni gnas 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po 'dri// khyed rnams 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis// gal te nga yi tshig las 'da' byed na// ye shes can gyi rdo rje 'bar ba yis// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar ni 'gas 'gyur zhing*// bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur pa gdon mi za// zhes pa lan gsum du brjod pas drag po'i sgo nas kyang bslang bar bya'o// de rnams kyis kyang ji ltar dga' bar gyis shig ces/

spro ba'i yid kyis byin par bsams la/ gshegs su gsol nas las kyi rjes bsdu'o// sa bslang ba'o// //de nas de ltar bslangs pa'i sa sbyang ba'i phyir/ rdo rje gnod mdzes kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su lto 'phye'i lto ba'i phyogs nas/ zabs su khru gang dang*/ rgyar dkyil 'khor gyi tshad pas cung zad lhag par brkos la gyo mo dang*/ rdo ba dang*/ rus pa dang*/ sol ba dang*/ thal ba dang*/ skra dang phub ma la sogs pa zug rngu rnams phyung nas/ sman dang*/ 'bru dang*/ rin po che sna tshogs pa dang bcas pa'i sa brnyan bzang pos bkang la 'thas par brdungs la/ dkyil 'khor gyi stegs bu brtsig par bya ste/ thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa de// khru ni bcu gnyis tshad du bya// zhes 'byung ba'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi ngos re la khru gsum gyi tshad du byas pas/ khor yug tu khru bcu gnyis kyi tshad dang ldan pa'am/ yang na ngos re la khru bcu gnyis kyi tshad dang ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'os pa'i stegs bu gru bzhi pa shar dang byang du gzhol zhing dbus cung zad mtho la me long gi ngos ltar 'jam pa byas nas/ dri bzang po dang sbyar ba'i ba byung lngas legs par byugs te/ me tog sil ma bkram pa ni sa sbyang ba'o// de nas byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi dbus dang phyogs thams cad du lag pa bzhag nas/ hūm̐ khaṃ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas rnam par dag pa'i nam mkhar bsam mo// de nas hūm̐ suṃ hūm̐ zhes pas/ rin po che bzhi'i rang bzhin las grub pa'i ri rab tu bsgom mo// de nas hūm̐ laṃ hūm̐ zhes pas de'i steng du/ gser gyi sa gzhi gru bzhi pa rdo rje'i phreng bas brgyan pa bsam mo// de'i steng du rdo rje thal mo bcings pa kha sbug tu bzhag la/ oṃ badz+ra me di nī badz+rī bha wa badz+ra ban+dha hūm̐/ zhes pas thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsam mo// de nas der sbyor ba gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa ni byin gyis brlab pa'o// de nas gzung ba ni/

dkyil 'khor gyi dbus dang*/ phyogs bzhir slob dpon dang las kyi slob ma bzhi stan nang tshangs can la 'khod la/ dang po'i sbyor bas bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rje dang*/ slob ma bzhi po/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhir bsgoms la/ so so'i bzlas pa ci rigs pa byas pa'i mthar/ slob ma bzhis rim pa bzhin gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// mtshan rnams thams cad yongs su rdzogs// mtshan min thams cad rnam par spangs// kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung*// ye shes spyod pa rnam spyod mdzad// kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhin dag pa dri ma med// kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo sgyur// dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ bdag nyid ting nge 'dzin las langs nas/ zhe sdang rdo rje khro bo chen por dmigs pa'i mig g.yas g.yon/ ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla bar gyur pa'i mig 'bras gnyis hūm̐ las rdo rje nag por bsams la/ g.yon nas g.yas su lta ba dang*/ g.yas nas g.yon du lta ba dang*/ bgegs rnams tshar gcad pa dang*/ rjes su gzung bar byas nas/ khro bo'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad du/ khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyis khyab par sprul lo// de nas krang pa'i mthil gnyis su a las 'od zer 'bar ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje gnyis bsgoms nas/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas langs la/ khro bo'i 'gying tshol ba lan gsum byas nas/ rdo rje snying gar bzung zhing dril bu gnas brgyad du dkrol nas hūm̐ zhes brjod do// de nas rdo rje dril bu dkur bzung nas/ khro bo'i gom pas dbang ldan du phyin te/

dbus su bltas la rdo rje snying ga dang dril bu dkur 'dzin pa/ snyems pa dang bcas pas bgegs kyi tshogs la 'di skad ces bka' bsgo bar bya'o// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can// sangs rgyas thams cad bdag la gson// bdag ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin// bka' yi 'khor lo rab sbyor gyis// lha dang lha min gsang ba pa// brjod byed la sogs bgegs kyi tshogs// sa 'dir ma gnas gzhan du dengs// gal te dam tshig las 'das na// rdo rje khro bo bzhin 'bar ba'i// rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba yis// mgo ni tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing*// zhig par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ lha dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ brjod byed dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ srul po dang*/ lus srul po dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi'am ci dang*/ rig sngags grub pa'i rjes su 'gro zhing 'khor dang bcas pa gang dag 'khod pa rnams dengs shig sa phyogs 'dir slob ma che ge mo zhes bya ba mngon par byang chub pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i ye shes rdzogs pa'i rgyur/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor chen po ngas 'dri bas/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' de dag la nyon la myur bar song shig gal te mi 'gro na nga'i rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad 'bar ba dang*/ ye shes kyi rdo rje rab tu 'bar bas/ mgo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par byed do// zhes lan gsum du brjod do// de nas shar du g.yas brkyang ba dang*/ lhor g.yon brkyang ba dang*/ nub tu sa ga dang*/ byang du zlum po la sogs pa'i rkang stabs dang*/ mdzes pa'i gom pa dang*/ khro bo'i gom pa la sogs pa'i gom stabs dang*/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung dang sems dpa'i skyil krung la sogs pa'i 'dug stabs dang*/ byang chub mchog dang*/ sa gnon la sogs pa'i phyag rgya dang*/

rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang*/ 'khor lo bskor ba la sogs pa'i lag pa'i stabs dang*/ zhi ba'i bzhin dang*/ 'dzum pa'i bzhin la sogs pa'i bzhin gyi 'gyur tshul dang*/ khro bo'i lta ba dang*/ zur gyis lta ba la sogs pa'i mig gi lta stangs dang*/ drug gi rjes su skye pa la sogs pa ngag gi 'dren pa rnams kyis/ dkyil 'khor gyi gnas kun byin gyis brlab cing*/ rkang pa'i rjes thams cad sna tshogs rdo rjer gyur par bsam mo// 'di dag rgyas par rnam par snang mdzad sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rgyud dang*/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i sa'i cho ga la sogs pa nas shes par bya'o// de dag ni stang stabs kyi bkod pas bzung ba'o// sa'i phyogs 'dir rdo rje slob dpon bdag gis dkyil 'khor chen po nges par bzhengs la/ gzhan gyi don brtsam par bya'o snyam pa ni blos bzung ba'o// de nas bsrung ba'i don du dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rje'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas 'dug la/ seng ldeng gi phur pa sor brgyad kyi tshad dang ldan pa la/ tsan+dan dmar pos byug cing*/ srad bu dmar po dang*/ me tog gi phreng bas brgyan la/ stod rdo rje gnod mdzes zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ lte ba man chad phur bu'i rnam pa can du bskyed pa'am/ yang na phur bu rnams khro bo bcur bskyed la ye shes pa dang ro gcig par byas nas/ dbang bskur te rigs kyi bdag pos cod paṇa du byas la/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyis bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong bcu dang bcas pa'i bgegs thams cad bkug nas/ dkar po'i phyogs la dga' ba thams cad byang chub kyi sems la bkod/ nag po'i phyogs rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus gdab pa'i phyir/ rang gi snying ga nas khro bo bcu spros pa'i g.yon pas gong gi phur bu rnams bzung*/ g.yas pas rdo rje tho ba bzung nas phyogs bcu'i gtso bo rnams dang bcas pa'i bgegs thams cad kyi spyi bor phur bus gdab/

rdo rje tho bas brdung bar bsam zhing khro bo so so'i sngags dang sbyar ba'i/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya la sogs pa dang*/ badz+ra muṅka ra la sogs pa brjod pas bgegs rnams kyi lus bsregs nas sdig pa sbyang bar bsam zhing*/ dngos su dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bcur phur bu rnams gdab/ de'ang steng gi shar dang*/ 'og gi nub kyi thad sor gdab par bya'o// de nas sa'i phyogs der sgrub pa'i thabs bzhin srung ba'i 'khor lo rgyas par bsgoms la/ sum+bha'i sngags yang yang bzlas pas brtan par bya ba ni bsrung ba ste/ sa'i cho ga'o// //sa yi lha mo lhag gnas dang*// lha dang de bzhin bum pa dang*// slob ma lhag par gnas pa ste// sta gon cho ga rnam pa bzhi// de la thog mar dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa rgyan gyis nye bar brgyan la/ stegs bu'i dbus su pan reg gi tshad kyi maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa ba byung lnga dri bzang dang bcas pas byugs pa'i khor yug tu mchod pa rnams kyis bskor zhing*/ gtor ma rnams dang*/ 'og tu nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams kyang sta gon du legs par bya'o// de nas phyi ma red kyi tshe rdo rje slob dpon sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pa so so'i stan la 'khod nas bgegs dang*/ 'byung po rnams la sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma byin la bar chad mi 'byung zhing las sgrub par bsgos nas/ gtor ma dor la mchod pa byin dbab cing*/ rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba btab nas/ yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyangs la/ rnal 'byor yongs su rdzogs par bsgoms nas sngags ci rigs par bzla'o// de nas rang gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor bsdus te/ gtso bo 'ba' zhig gi nga rgyal dang ldan pas mchod rdzas rnams bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags kyis bsang zhing*/ swa bhā was sbyangs nas/ yi ge gsum las lha rdzas kyi mchod pa phun sum tshogs par bskyed la/ so so'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlab bo// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dri'i thig le dang bcas pa'i tshom bu/

oṃ pri thi wī de wī zhes pas bkod la lag pa g.yas pa sa gnon gyi phyag rgyas sa la reg zhing*/ oṃ ṭak+ki hūm̐ dzaḥzhes brjod pas sa'i lha mo bskul nas gser gyi mdog can/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lag pa gnyis kyis gser gyi bum pa 'dzin cing*/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan pa/ me tog tshom bu'i dbus su lus phyed 'thon nas/ bdag la mngon tu phyogs par bsams la/ mchod pa rnams kyis dngos su mchod/ gtor ma phul la rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par dang*// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud kyi sde// pham par byas te dkyil 'khor bri// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/ rig pa 'dzin pa ci bde bar spyod cig ces gnang ba byin nas slar yang mchod de/ gshegs su gsol bas de nyid du thim par bsam mo// de nas lha sta gon du gnas par bya ba'i phyir/ me tog dman ma rnams bsdus la/ ba las byung ba lngas g.yas skor du khye ma med par byug cing*/ oṃ me di nī badz+rī bha wa ban+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod pas rdo rje'i sa gzhir bsgoms nas/ der sa bon las bskyed pa'am/ skad cig gis srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang yongs su rdzogs par bskyed la/ lha'i gnas rnams su dri'i thig le re'i steng du/ me tog gi tshom bu re bkod nas/ rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rje yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs nas sku'i dbyibs brgyud de yum gyi mkhar babs pa lha sum cu so gnyis su gyur pa rnams badz+ra dhṛka la sogs pa'i 'byin sngags kyis phyung nas/ tshom bu so so la bkod pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par gsal btab nas/

sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs la/ sems dpa' sum brtsegs su gsal bar dmigs nas ye shes sems dpa' dang ro gcig par byas la/ dbang bskur nas so so'i rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab bo// de nas phyi nang gsang ba yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod cing*/ bstod pa rnams kyis bstod la/ snyan gsan dbab pa'i phyir/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas/ bdug spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa mchog /rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje'i bdag nyid can rnams kyi// dkyil 'khor bdag ni 'dri bar 'tshal// slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*// khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la// de nas gnang bar mdzad pa'i rigs// sangs rgyas 'gro don mdzad brtson dang*// byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang*// gang gzhan gsang sngags lha rnams dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang*// gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang*// gang su rdo rje'i spyan mnga' ba'i// sems can bstan la dga' ba rnams// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// rdo rje 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor ni// yo byad ji ltar 'byor pa yis// 'gro ba dag phyir bdag 'dri na// deng bdag slob mar bcas pa la// thugs brtse bar ni dgongs nas su// tshogs pa thams cad dkyil 'khor du// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu/ rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod kyis dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam mo// de nas lha dang 'byung po gtor mas mnyes par byas la/ bum pa sta gon du gnas pa'i cho ga bya ste/ rin po che la sogs pa'i rgyu las byung ba'i bum pa/ lto ba'i rgyar mtho lnga la mgrin pa'i dpang du sor brgyad pa/ kha khyer dang mchu sor gnyis 'phyang ba/

rtsa ba zlum zhing kha dog nag po dang bral ba'i bum pa lha'i grangs dang mnyam pa'am/ ma 'byor na las thams cad pa'i bum pa dang gnyis la/ mgul chings gtsang ma prog lnga'am bdun dang ldan pa dkris shing*/ me tog dang 'bras bus spud pa'i rtse mo ma nyams pa'i shing gi yal gas kha brgyan la/ gser dngul mu tig byi ru mu men te rin chen lnga dang*/ nas 'bras sran ma gro til te 'bru lnga/ sing h+yaḥbya gri ha sa ha sa de wa kar+ṇi ka ste sman lnga/ ga pur gur gum tsan+dan dkar dmar dzā ti ste dri lnga/ 'o ma zho mar lan tshwa bu ram ste snying po lnga/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ste/ gsang ba'i rdzas rnams dang bcas pa/ lu ma dang*/ 'bab chu dang*/ khron pa las byung ba'i chus gang bar byas la/ lha so so'i mtshan ma rnams gdags shing*/ rnam rgyal gyi bum pa la dung chos dri'i chus yongs su gang ba'i steng du/ rdo rje la gzungs thag btags pa gzhag go /de nas bum pa rnams bsang zhing sbyangs nas paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i steng du/ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las byung ba'i bum pa rnams su bskyed nas/ lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i bum pa la ni/ re re'i nang du lha re re bskyed la/ rnam rgyal gyi bum pa 'ba' zhig las med na/ de'i nang du dkyil 'khor gyi lha rdzogs par bskyed do// de nas gzhal yas khang gi dod bum pa nyid yin la/ lha rnams ni lhag par mos pa tsam mam/ yang na dkyil 'khor cho ga nyi shu pa las 'byung ba ltar so so'i sa bon las bskyed do// las thams cad pa'i bum par ni bgegs mthar byed bskyed de/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ ye shes pa bcug la dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas btab pa la/ phyi dang gsang ba yid las byung bas mchod de/ gtor mas kyang mnyes par byas nas/ dung chos kyi nang du lha rnams kyi gzugs brnyan gsal bar dmigs la/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags 'phros pa gzungs thag la brten nas song bas lha rnams kyi thugs kar phog ste/

rgyud bskul nas sku thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun zag pas bum pa gang bar bsam zhing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha so so'i sngags sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin bzla/ las thams cad pa la/ oṃ a bigh+nān ta kri ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa bzla'o// slar yang mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la/ dung chos kyi chu bum pa rnams kyi nang du blugs la/ lha thams cad 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi chur bsams nas/ bum pa rnams kyi chu cung zad re rnam rgyal gyi bum par bsdu'o// de nas dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma rnams tshogs kyi 'khor los mnyes par byas la/ lhag ma la dga' ba'i 'byung po rnams lhag ma'i gtor mas tshim par bya'o// de nas slob ma lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga ni/ nges 'byung bsam pa bskyed pa dang*// gsol dang nang gi dbang bskur dang*// spro ba bskyed dang sdom pa sbyin// bsrung dang mchod dang so shing dor// skyor chu blud dang srung skud bcing*// sdig pa sbyang dang ku sha sbyin// chos bshad rmi lam yongs brtag pa// bcu bzhi slob ma'i sta gon no// de la thog mar gong du rjes su bzung ba'i slob ma rnams khrus byas shing*/ gos gtsang ma bgos la phyag 'tshal ba sngon du 'gro bas gral la 'khod pa rnams la/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed pa'i phyir/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug bya ste// bsod nams 'dod pas 'di las gzhan// gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol gnyer// dad pa chen por ldan byas te// 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer na// blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug bya ste// 'di yi 'bras bu 'dod mi bya// gal te 'di la dmigs gyur na// 'jig rten pha rol 'byung ma yin// 'jig rten pha rol don gnyer ba'i// mi la 'di 'bras ma lus 'grub// ces brjod nas don yang bshad do// de ltar myang ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan pos kun nas bslangs nas/

bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed/ de las dbang blang ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar la/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid stsal du gsol// byang chub sems ni bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag ni bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba 'debs su gzhug go /de ltar gsol ba 'debs pa'i/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i snod du rung bar bya ba'i phyir/ rang zhe sdang rdo rje yab yum gsal bar dmigs la/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te/ snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i sgras/ slob ma rnams bkug nas zhal du zhugs te/ snying gar 'od du zhu nas/ rdo rje'i lam nas babs pa rnams mi bskyod rdo rje yab yum du bskyed la/ slar yang snying ga'i 'od kyis de bzhin gshegs pa spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zhu ba byang chub kyi sems su gyur pa rdo rje'i lam nas brgyud de/ he ru ka rnams kyi spyi bor thim pas ro gcig tu gyur te/ de nyid kyis dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas btab la/ hūm̐ gis sbyor mtshams nas spros la rim pas dgod do// de ltar snod du rung bar byas pa'i slob ma rnams sngags kyi lam la spro bar bya ba'i phyir/ bu tshur theg pa chen po yi// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bshad par bya// dus gsum du ni legs 'byung ba'i// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can// sangs rgyas ye shes mnyam med pa// rdo rje sngags kyi stobs kyis thob// sngags gyi sbyor ba mnyam med de// drag po chen po bdud kyi sde// stobs chen dag kyang de yi bcom// shākya seng ge mchog la sogs// 'jig rten mthun par gshegs nas kyang*// 'khor lo bskor nas mya ngan 'das// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig

/ces brjod nas don yang bshad do// de ltar yid spro bar gyur pa'i slob ma rnams la lam gyi gzhi/ byang chub kyi sems dang sdom pa sbyin pa'i phyir/ thog mar rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub kyi sems sbyin par bya ste/ don dran bzhin pas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas// sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer// byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum brjod du gzhug go /de nas gzung bar bya ba'i phyir dam tshig dang*/ sdom pa shes par bya ba'i phyir/ bsgrag par bya ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*// 'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig brtan par gyur ba'o// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// blo chen khyod kyis gzung bar gyis// byang chub sems gang de rdo rje// shes rab dril bu zhes bsgrags so// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar gyis// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs// rin chen rigs mchog chen po la// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam chos khyod kyis gzung bar gyis// 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar gyis// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus byos// srog chags rnams ni gsad mi bya// ma byin par yang mi blang ngo*// 'dod spyod dag kyang mi bya zhing*// brdzun du smra bar mi bya'o// nyes pa kun gyi rtsa ba yi// chang ni rnam par spang bar bya// sems can gdul ba ma gtogs pa// bya ba ma yin thams cad spangs// dam pa nye bar bsten bya zhing*// rnal 'byor can kun bsnyen bkur bya// lus kyi las ni rnams gsum dang*// ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang*// yid gyi rnam pa gsum dag ni// ci nus pas ni rjes su bsrung*// sems can don la rgyab mi phyogs// theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya// 'khor ba dag kyang yongs mi spang*// rtag tu mya ngan 'das mi chags// lha dang lha min gsang ba pa// de la brnyes par mi bya zhing*// phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang*// mtshan ma bsgom par mi bya'o// de ltar dam tshig gsungs pa dag

/blo ldan khyod kyis rtag tu srungs// zhes brjod nas don yang rgyas par bshad do// de nas de ltar bsgrags pa rnams gzung zhing byang chub bar du bskyang ba'i bsam pas/ don dran bzhin pas 'di skad ces brjod du gzhug go /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba ni// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// so sor brtan por gzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas bdag gis gzung*// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog rnal 'byor gyi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re zhing ni dus drug tu// zang zing mi 'jigs dam chos dang*// byams pa rin chen rigs mchog gi /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam chos so sor gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba ni dgrol bar bgyi// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la dgod// ces lan gsum gyis dam tshig dang sdom pa sbyin no// de nas bsrung ba'i phyir las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chu sngags dang bcas pas gtor zhing bsangs nas/

lag pa g.yas pa rdo rje dang bcas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyi srin lag gis bum pa'i chu blangs pas/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar reg cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas rim pa bzhin du/ oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa dang*/ āḥlas pad+ma dmar po āḥs mtshan pa dang*/ hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur nas/ slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum bsrung bar bsam mo// de ltar sku gsung thugs rdo rje phyag rgyas bsrungs pa'i slob ma rnams mchod pa'i gnas su gyur pas me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams kyis mchod par bya'o// de nas bla ma'i mdun du maṇ+ḍal zlum po khru gang gi tshad dang ldan pa la/ bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags bzla zhing*/ ba las byung ba dri bzang po dang bcas pas byugs pa'i dbus su me tog gi tshom bu gcig bkod la/ slob mas me tog phul nas/ bla ma'i mdun du kha byang du phyogs te 'dug pa la/ dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i phyir 'o ma can gyi shing gi yal ga phra mo sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad dang ldan pa'i rtse mo tog gis brgyan pa/ oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha/ zhes brjod nas byin pa/ slob mas thal mo sbyar bas blangs te/ so brud la/ sdig pa thams cad skyugs par bsam zhing*/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su dor ro// gal te maṇ+ḍal gyi khongs su ma lhung na/ skal ba med pa'i phyir dbang mi bskur la/ dbus su lhung na rtse mo gang du phyogs pas dngos grub kyi ltas brtag par bya ste/ shar du phyogs pas zhi ba/ lho drag po/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du rgyas pa/ steng du bltas pas mkha' spyod/ 'og tu bltas pas sa 'og gi dngos grub/ mtshams rnams su dngos grub phra mo/ bdag nyid la phyogs te 'dug na mchog 'grub par lung ston no// de nas rmi lam gsal bar mthong ba'i phyir/ bam̐ las byung ba'i dung chos kyi chu las/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha sarba dharma sarba pā paṃ ni tsa s+ya saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpā na a pa nā ya hūm̐/

zhes pa'i sngags kyis mngon par bsngags te/ slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par byin nas/ 'thung du gzhug go /de nas bar chad mi 'byung ba'i don du/ bu mos bkal ba'i skud pa sum sgril la rdo rje'i mdud pa bcings pa/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje'i srad bur dmigs la/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi skud pa spyan drangs nas bstim ste/ gtso bo'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ bud+dha mā traṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa sarbā na swā hā/ zhes brjod cing dpung pa g.yas par bcing ngo*// de nas sdig pa sbyang ba'i phyir/ sngar gyi dung chos kyi chu srin lag gis blangs la/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar reg cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod pas sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyang bar bsams la/ sngar gyi sngags kyis mngon par bsngags pa'i khyor chu gnyis pa'ang 'thung du gzhug go /de nas rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa'i don du rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa'i ku sha'i chun po che chung gnyis la/ oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣ+ṇa baṃ zhes pa'i sngags kyis mngon par bsngags la/ chung ba g.yas dang che ba g.yon du sbyin no// de nas yid spro ba brtan cing mi ldog par bya ba'i phyir/ chos zab mo bshad par bya ste/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wā re'i me tog ltar// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis mnyam med sems can don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus// sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos bstan pa// bden pa gnyis la yang dag brten// 'jig rten kun rdzob bden pa dang*// dam pa'i don gyi bden pa'o// zab cing rgya che zhes bshad pa// rnam par rtog med zab pa ste// rgya che sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku// 'di ni bden pa gnyis su bshad// kun rdzob dang ni dam pa'i don// phye ste so sor shes nas su// de nas gcig tu 'dres byas pa'i// zag med go 'phang bsgom par bya// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*// dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag

/de dag thams cad zad par 'gyur// gang gis spyod pa'i mchog 'di la// blo gros shin tu dri med na// sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi// ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa bla med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa'i// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su gzung ste skye bzhin par// bdag nyid chen po khyed gnas te// gang gis khyed rnams theg chen du// sang ni rab tu skye 'gyur pa// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams 'dir ni dong bas na// rang 'byung skal ba chen po ba// 'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur// zhes brjod nas don yang rgyas par bshad do// de nas bu kye nang par dkyil 'khor dag /mthong bar 'gyur ro nyol cig dang*// rmi lam mthong ba gang yin pa// de kun dang por nga la smros// zhes brjod nas ku sha che ba stan dang chung ba sngas su bcug la/ rtog pa gzhan gyis ma g.yengs par bdag gis dkyil 'khor ji lta bu zhig mthong bar 'gyur zhig gu snyam pa'i yid dang ldan pas/ gzhogs g.yas pa 'og tu bcug pa'i seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis nyol cig ces bsgos la btang*/ de nas tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la mchod cing bstod de/ bzod par gsol nas/ oṃ badz+ro tiṣ+ṭha zhes pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya ldan pas steng gi nam mkha' la bteg nas slar yang*/ mchod cing bstod la de nyid du bzhugs par gsol ba gdab bo// de nas tshom bu rnams bsdus nas dri bzang po dang bcas pa'i ba byung gis byugs la/ gtor ma'i mgron gshegs su gsol zhing*/ gtor ma nyid kyang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas dor la/ bdag nyid kyi gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bkod nas/ sum+bha'i sngags kyis bsrungs la 'od gsal gyi ngang la nyal bar bya'o// nang par slob mas rmi lam bshad pa de'i tshe/

dge ba'i mtshan ma mthong na sems spro ba bskyed do// mi dge ba'i mtshan ma mthong na bgegs dang bcas pa la ni/ bgegs kyi gtor ma byin la/ gnod mdzes kyi sngags dang ting nge 'dzin dang bum pa'i chus bskrad cing bsrung ngo*// bgegs dang bcas pa ma yin pa'i rmi lam mi dge ba mthong na/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dang*/ sangs rgyas spyan gyi sngags dang rnal 'byor la sogs pas zhi bar bya'o// lhag par gnas pa sta gon gyi cho ga'o// dkyil 'khor gyi ni bya ba dang*// bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang dang*// slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba// dngos gzhi'i bya ba rnam pa gsum// thig tshon mtshan ma dgod pa yis// dkyil 'khor bri dang rgyan dgram dang*// bsgrub pa dang ni mchod pa ste// dkyil 'khor bya ba rnam pa bzhi// de la thog mar thig gis bris pa'i phyir/ tho rangs kyi cha la 'od gsal zung 'jug tu lha'i skur langs nas/ las kyi thig gis cha dbye ba'i phyir las kyi slob ma dang bcas pa/ lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas thig skud gsar pa 'jur mdud med cing mdzes la tshad dang ldan pa thig chal gyis spangs nas/ shar gyi dbus dang*/ nub kyi dbus nas tshangs pa'i thig dang po gdab bo// de nas dbus su mtshan ma byas pa nas/ shar dang nub kyi tshangs pa'i thig steng du khru re dor ba'i gnas su mtshan ma re bya'o// de nas shar nub kyi mtshan ma gnyis dang mnyam pa'i srad bu bzung la/ shar gyi mtshan ma nas byang du bskor ba dang*/ nub kyi mtshan ma nas byang du bskor bas byang gi bya rog rjes dang*/ shar nas lho dang nub nas lhor bskor bas lho'i bya rog rjes btsal la/ bya rog rjes gnyis kyi steng nas tshangs pa'i thig gnyis pa gdab bo// de nas dbus nas ngos bzhir khru gnyis la sogs pa/ che chung ji tsam bya bar 'dod pa'i tshad kyi mtshan ma bzhi byas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyed tshad pas cung zad ring ba'i srad bu shar la sogs pa'i mtshan ma'i steng du bzung la/

shar lho la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhir g.yas skor du bskor ba dang*/ byang shar nas brtsams te g.yon skor du bskor bas/ grwa bzhi'i bya rog gi rjes btsal ba'i steng nas ngos kyi thig bzhi dang*/ zur thig gnyis gdab bo// de nas grwa bzhi bcad pa'i bya rog gi rjes kyi steng nas btab pas cha bzhir bgo ba dang*/ de yang grwa bzhir bcad pa'i bya rog gi rjes rnams kyi steng du btab pas cha brgyad dang*/ de'i yang grwa bzhir bcad pa'i bya rog gi rjes rnams kyi steng du btab pas cha chen bcu drug tu rnam par dbye'o// de nas cha phran rnam par dbye ba ni/ gcig drug phyed gdab phyi ma gdab// gnyis dang bzhi pa cha bzhir bgo /lnga brgyad mtha' gdab dbus ma dor// sgo dang sgo rkang cha gcig ste// sgo logs sgo khyud 'dod yon dang*// drwa phyed chos 'khor cha phyed do// pan rag pha gu mda' yab dang*// mun khang rta babs bang rim bzhin// pad+ma gdugs rnams cha phran re// 'di dag rnam par brkyang ba'i thig /de nas bskor ba'i thig bya ba'i phyir/ dbus su tsan+dan la sogs pa las grub pa'i phur bu/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya baṃ hūm̐ zhes bzla zhing btab pa la/ nang gi cha chen gsum pa'i cha phran bzhi pa dang*/ gsum pa la rim pa gnyis bskor ba la rdo rje'i phreng ba dang 'od kyi phreng ba bya'o// cha chen gnyis pa'i cha phran dang po la/ rdo rje'i gdung du byas pa'i dbus gru bzhi gtso bo'i gnas dang cha chen dang po'i cha phran gnyis pa la phyi'i phyogs bzhir ka ba gnyis gnyis las byas pa'i pho brang le tshe dgu par bya'o// cha chen bzhi pa la ni lha snam mo// de nas cha chen brgyad pa'i mtha' nas cha bran gsum bskor ba mu khyud la phyi'i pad+ma'i phreng ba dang*/ de nas cha phran phyed dang gsum la rdo rje'i rwa ba dang*/ yang cha phran phyed dang gsum la me'i phreng ba dang*/ de nas cha phran gnyis la dkyil 'khor gyi nye 'khor gyi sa bya'o// de nas ye shes kyi thig gi byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/

thog mar thig tshon byin gyis brlab par bya ste/ rin po che'am/ 'bras sam/ ji snyed pa'i rgyu las byung ba'i rdul tshon nag po la hūm̐/ dkar po la oṃ/ ser po la swā/ dmar po la āḥ ljang gu la hā/ bris pa rnams dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bkod pa'i steng du/ thig skud sbom du sgo'i nyi shu cha/ chur dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur gyi tshad dang ldan pa/ so so'ang lnga sgril du byas pa 'jur mdud dang*/ sbom phra dang*/ ring thung gi nyes pa dang bral ba/ kha dog lngar bsgyur ba rnams rdul tshon so so'i steng du gzhag go /de'i mdun du mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams la/ bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du song bas thig mtshon bsang zhing sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las gdan so so'i steng du/ sa bon so so las rigs lnga yab yum du bskyed nas byin gyis brlabs te/ bdag gi mig g.yas g.yon dza dkar dmar las nyi zla dzas mtshan par bskyed la gyen du lta zhing rdzi ma myur du brdabs pas/ sta gon gyi lha'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi tshon dang thig skud spyan drangs la/ gnyis su med par bstim nas/ slar yang sta gon gyi lha de nyid kyis dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūm̐/ oṃ āḥswā hūm̐/ oṃ āḥ.āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhā hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing byin gyis brlab bo// de nas mchod pa dang bstod pa dang*/ gtor mas mnyes par byas nas yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas rjes su chags pa'i mes zhu ba las byung ba'i thig tshon du bsams nas/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya sū traṃ ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis mnye'o// de nas rang nyid mi bskyod rdo rje dang*/ las kyi slob ma reg rdo rje'am/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi nub dang shar du langs la dzaḥzhes brjod nas bla mas slob ma la thig sna gtad cing des kyang dzaḥzhes brjod nas blangs te/

mnyam par brkyang nas bsgril zhing chos thams cad ro gcig par bsgoms la/ oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga ta sarba dharmā s+pha ra pa ra a nu ga ta sarba dharmā a t+ya n+ta a nu ga ta sarba dharma/ a t+ya ta a nu pra be sha ya sarba dharma hūm̐/ zhes brjod do// de nas rdo rje'i lte bar dkris nas yi ge gsum brjod cing dri bzang po dang bdud rtsi gtor nas/ slob dpon shar bltas slob ma nub// tshangs thig dang po gdab par bya// slob dpon lho 'dug slob ma byang*// gnyis pa yang ni gdab par bya// me yi phyogs su gnas pa yis// byang bltas shar gyi thig gdab bya// rlung gnas lhor bltas nub thig gdab// de nyid nas ni byang ngos gdab// mer gnas lho phyogs thig bya zhing*// de nas rlung gi phyogs su bya// bden bral gnas pas dbang ldan bar// rim pa ji bzhin gdab par bya// de'i tshe/ nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas rnams// 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags pas// khyed rnams 'dir ni gshegs gsol bar// thig skud sgras ni bskul bar bgyi// zhes pa dang gong gi sngags kyang brjod cing*/ slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis thig gdab bo// de ltar thig chen brgyad btab pas gzhal yas khang gi rnam par grub par blta'o// de nas shar nub tu bltas te/ rdo rje'i lte ba la thig skud dkris te/ slar yang bdud rtsi gtor nas/ oṃ badz+ra be ga kra ma ho// zhes bya ba phyag rgya dang bcas pas ye shes kyi thig rnams nam mkha' la bteg nas/ rdo rje dril bu dkur 'dzin pas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su song la/ 'gying bag dang bcas pas phyogs bzhir mig shin tu gdangs pas blta zhing hi zhes brjod pas sgo bzhi bye bar bsams mo// de nas tshon gyis bri ba'i phyir slob dpon dbus nas shar du bltas te/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes pas rdul tshon rnams mngon par bsngags la/ g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa nang nas rim pa bzhin/

nag po/ ljang gu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po rnams sgo logs kyi ring thung dang mnyam pa/ sbom phra dang*/ 'dres pa dang*/ bar chad pa la sogs pa'i nyes pa dang bral bas g.yas skor du bri zhing*/ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste// sems can rnams ni rnam grol byed// rdo rje 'dzin pa rgyal chen gyi// dkyil 'khor chen po bri bar bya// zhes brjod do// de nas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ dbus kyi phur bu phyung nas/ rdul tshon lngas rtsig pa'i rim pa dang mthun pas dgang ngo*// de nas las kyi slob ma rnams kyis bri bar bya ste/ dbus sngo/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ gdung dang ka ba'i gzhi nag po la/ rdo rje'i gdung ser po/ ka ba rnams phyogs kyi mdog can/ rigs so so'i mtshan mas mtshan pa/ mu khyud kyi rdo rje ser po la me'i phreng ba sna tshogs su bri zhing*/ lha snam dmar po la nang gi grwa bzhir kha rgyan dang bcas pa'i bum pa ser po brgyad bri'o// phyi'i dkyil 'khor ni/ 'dod yon dmar po pha gu ser// drwa ba'i gzhi ni nag po la// drwa ba drwa phyed sna tshogs mdog /mda' yab cher bkra pu shu ni// gser gyi mdog tu bri bar bya// mun khang cher gnag zla phyed dkar// rta babs bang rim bzhi po ni// mdzes pa'i tshon gyis spel te bri// chos 'khor dkar po ri dwags ser// gdugs sogs ji ltar mdzes pa ste// sna tshogs rdo rje phyogs kyi mdog /phyi rol khor yug pad+ma'i phreng*// sna tshogs spel bas cher bkra zhing*// phyi rol mu khyud nag po la// gser gyi rdo rje'i phreng ba bri// me yi phreng ba sna tshogs mdog /de nas mtshan ma dgod pa ni// dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rdo rje sngon po shar nas brtsams te/ re mig bzhir/ 'khor lo dkar po/ rin po che ser po/ pad+ma dmar po/ ral gri ljang gu nang gi grwa bzhir shar lho nas brtsams te/ mig 'bras kyis mtshan pa'i 'khor lo dkar po/

rdo rje sngon po/ pad+ma dmar po/ ut+pa la ljang gu/ lha snam nang gi grwa bzhir shar lho nas brtsams te/ me long dkar po/ pi wang ser po/ dung chos dmar po/ zhal zas kyi snod ljang gu/ phyi'i lha snam gyi shar gyi g.yon du 'khor lo/ g.yas su klu shing gi me tog lhor rin po che gnyis/ nub tu pad+ma gnyis/ byang du ral gri gnyis bri ste phyogs kyi mdog can no// shar la sogs pa'i sgo bzhir/ tho ba/ rdo rje/ dbyug pa/ pad+ma/ sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar lho nas grwa bzhir/ ral gri/ lcags kyu/ dbyug pa/ rtse gsum/ shar gyi steng du 'khor lo/ nub kyi steng du rdo rje/ de rnams kyang lho'i dkar po/ nub kyi dmar po/ gzhan rnams ni sngon por bri'o// khro bo bcu'i gdan ni nyi ma yin la/ gzhan rnams ni zla ba'i gdan yin zhing*/ phyag mtshan rnams so so'i sngags brjod cing dgod par bya'o// de nas rgyan dgram pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug thams cad du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod rdzas thams cad kyis g.yas skor du bskor zhing gzhan yang bla bre dang*/ lda ldi dang*/ dar gyi chun 'phyang dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ tshon sna lnga'i drwa ba dang*/ 'phan dang rgyal mtshan la sogs pa mdzes shing mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan rnams kyis brgyan par bya'o// lha dang 'byung po'i gtor ma rnams kyang bsham zhing*/ 'og tu nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams kyang 'tshog chas bya'o// de nas bsgrub pa'i phyir/ phyi ma red kyi dus su sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pa so so'i gdan la 'khod pa nas brtsams te/ mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa sta gon gyi skabs ltar byas nas/ rang gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor bsdus la/ gtso bo yab yum gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du song nas/ lus la dri bzang pos bsgos shing rgyan gyis brgyan la dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su stan nang tshangs can la 'khod de sum+bha'i sngags kyis/

rdul tshon gyi bgegs sbyang bar bya'o// slob dpon gyis mtshan ma dgod pa'i sngon du gsungs kyang 'di nyid du bya bar rigs so// de nas swa bhā was sbyangs nas stong pa'i ngang las gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa/ sgrub thabs bzhin yongs su rdzogs par bskyed do// lha rnams kyang lhag par mos pa tsam gyis bskyed la/ bdag nyid gtso bo yab yum gyi mkha' gsang dang gnas lnga byin gyis brlabs nas/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad zhal du zhugs nas/ thugs kar 'od du zhu zhing*/ yum gyi bha gar babs pa rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs par gyur par dmigs nas/ 'byin sngags rnams kyis rim pa bzhin du phyung ba dpag tu med par gyur nas/ zhing khams kun tu 'phros pas rang gi rigs dang mthun pa'i sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha so so la thim par bsam mo// rten gyi dkyil 'khor yang phyung ste spros pas/ zhing yongs su dag par byas nas/ tshur 'dus te rten gyi dkyil 'khor la thim par bsam mo// de nas gtso bo yab yum gyi sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi sa bon gsal gdab cing*/ dkyil 'khor pa dang bcas pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang skye mched byin gyis brlabs nas/ thams cad kyang sems dpa' sum brtsegs su blta'o// de nas bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis bgegs bskrad cing srung ba'i 'khor lo kha phye la sta gon gyi lha la mchod cing bstod nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang gnyis su med par bya'o// slar yang ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' 'od kyi snang bas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad nam mkha'i gtos khyab pas bskor ba spyan drangs par bsam zhing*/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon du mdzad// mi bzad bdud kyi dpung gis phyag byas shing*// rang byung mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rang bzhin te// sems can snying po gcig gyur 'dir gshegs shig

/ces lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdza dza/ zhes brjod pas mdun gyi nam mkha' la spyan drangs pa/ mchod pa dang bstod pas mnyes par byas nas/ sgo ba bzhi'i sngags dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ phyag rgyas dgug pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ dbang du bya bas gnyis su med par byas la/ slar yang dbang bskur gyi lha spyan drangs pa la mchod cing bstod de/ gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur nas/ rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas btab pa la/ dbang gi lha dang yang ro gcig par byas nas/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsdams la/ lha so so'i mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i yi ge brgya pa brjod pas byin gyis brlab par bya'o// de nas mchod pa ni mchod yon la sogs pa phyi dang*/ nang bdud rtsi dang*/ rjes su chags pa gsang ba dang*/ sprul pa yid las byung ba dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ lha dang*/ chos skyong dang*/ phyogs skyong dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ mkha' 'gro rnams la gtor ma'i mchod pas mnyes par byas nas/ dkyil 'khor blta bar mi dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol du gtor ma rgya cher bshams la/ byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'byung po'i tshogs rnams nye bar bkug la/ oṃ da sha di ka bya ba s+thi te bh+yaḥ i ha s+thā na/ a ba s+thi te bh+yaḥ sarba de wa/ nā ga yak+ṣa gan+dha rba/ a su ra/ ga ru ra/ kin+na ra/ ma ho ra ga bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsi/ kum+bhaṇ+ḍa/ um+mā da/ a pa smā ra/ o sta ra gā di bh+yo/ i maṃ ba liṃ nī ya mā ne gṛ hi ta su kha sau sa ma na s+ya la bi no/ bha wan+tu s+thā na ni/ nir u pa dra bi na kur wān+tu/ sarba bhū ta a dhiṣ+ṭhā ni na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ i daṃ a mṛ ta pa ṇa ḍaṃ bhu ka traṃ/ ma ma sa pa ri wā ra s+ya shān+tiṃ kurban tu swa sti swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul nas mchod de/ phrin las bcol nas gshegs su gsol la 'bud dkrol dang bcas pas/ gtor ma dor bar bya'o// de nas rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi khang par zhugs la/

yi ge brgya pa brjod cing dkyil 'khor la g.yas phyogs su lan gsum bskor ba bya'o// dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba'o// de nas bdag nyid 'jug pa'i phyir/ dngos sam yid kyis nub phyogs su song la/ rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya byas nas/ shar gyi sgo phye bar bsams la/ oṃ badz+ro da gha ṭa sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod par bya'o// de bzhin du byang nas lho dang*/ shar nas nub dang*/ lho nas byang gi sgo phye la/ rang nyid shar phyogs su gnas nas/ phyi dang nang gi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa/ sngon du 'gro ba can gyi dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par blang ngo*// de nas rang gi rgyud la rdo rje'i dam tshig bsgrub pa dang*/ slob ma gzhug pa'i phyir bden pa'i byin rlabs brjod par bya ste/ oṃ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir// thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin// rdo rje sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod// kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste// dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal// mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod// nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa'ang khyod// 'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa// 'dod chags chen po dga' ba che// bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod// shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// byang chub sems dpar bdag grub mdzod// dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya'i mchog /grub pa rdo rje cher bstod pa// rdo rje snyems bdag bdag mdzod cing*// sems can kun gyi yid khyab cing*// sems can kun gyi snying la zhugs// sems can kun gyi yab gyur cing*// 'dod chags dam tshig mchog gyur pa'o// bden pa gang gis ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi// bden pa de yis mgon bdag la// khyed kyi 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu byung*// de bzhin nyid las des par skyes// bden pa 'di yis dkyil 'khor du// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma ni// kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog

/ces lan gsum brjod do// slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'o// de nas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams tsa ru'i bza' bas tshim par byas nas/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ bla ma lha la gsol gdab dang*// gdong g.yogs bcing dang phreng ba sbyin// gsang dang byin rlabs 'dod pa dri// byang chub sems gnyis bskyed pa dang*// gsang bar gdams nas nang du gzhug /phyi yi 'jug pa rnam pa bcu// de la thog mar kha dang gdong dag par bkrus pa'i slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol lam/ yol ba'i phyi rol du rim pa bzhin du 'khod de/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du song nas/ mā ma kī dang rab sbyor ba'i// dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// zhes pa la sogs pas bla ma la lan gsum du gsol ba gdab par bya'o// bla mas kyang slob ma gzhug pa'i don du/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'od gsal ba las yang dag byung*// rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen po// gzugs brnyan gyi ni dpe yang ste// dkyil 'khor yang ni de dang mtshungs// bden pa 'di yis slob ma rnams// thugs kyi dkyil 'khor dag tu gzhug /'khor lo rdzu 'phrul ma lus pa// mthong nas sdig pa ma lus spong*// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// rdo rje ye shes sgrub byed pa// snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi// chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*// dam tshig dran pas zhugs pa la// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis// phun sum tshogs pa thams cad stsol// zhes lan gsum gyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha la gsol ba gdab bo// de nas sngon chad ma rig pa dang sred pa'i dbang du gyur pas dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba mtshon pa'i phyir dar dmar po la/ oṃ tsak+ṣuḥban+dhaṃ ba ra ma ṇā ya hūm̐/ oṃ pra be sha bha ga wān ma hā su kha mok+ṣa su raṃ sarba sid+dhi su kha pra taṃ ba ra ma su khot+ma sid+dhaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥpra sid+dh+ya swā/

zhes pas mngon par bsngags pas gdong bcings pa/ bigh+nān ta kṛ ta kyi sngags brjod cing*/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chus bsangs la/ lce'i steng du bdud rtsi sbyin zhing*/ yi ge gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ slob ma rnam par snang mdzad du lhag par mos la/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ me tog gi phreng ba gtad nas snod du rung ba dang*/ mi rung ba nges par brtag pa'i phyir/ bu khyod su ci la dga' zhes dri zhing*/ des kyang skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o// zhes lan gdab/ slar yang de yis bu la ci zhig bya// zhes dris pa'i lan du/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes lan 'debs su gzhug go /de ltar slob ma nges par snod du rung bar gyur pa'i sems/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bdag nyid can gyi byang chub kyi sems su byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ slob ma'i snying gi nang du/ a las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bor dmigs pa'i steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po rtse mo lnga pa/ 'od 'phro ba don dam pa byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bor bsgom du bcug la/ snying gar slob dpon gyis rdo rje bzhag nas/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho/ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ zhes pas sems bskyed la/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams la smra bar ma byed cig dad pa dang mi ldan pa rnams la yang ma yin no// zhes gsang bar gdams nas sgo ba bzhi las rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa 'phros pas slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i nang du bcug par bsam zhing sgo ba bzhi'i sngags dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdang spel ba'am/

a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ zhes brjod cing las kyi slob dpon gyis rdo rje bzung ba la slob ma 'dzin du bcug nas nang du khrid de gzhug par bya'o// yol ba'i phyi rol gyi cho ga'o// //de nas nang du 'jug pa'i cho ga ni/ phyag 'tshal ba dang sdom pa sbyin// dam la gzhag dang ye shes dbab// me tog dor dang dkyil 'khor bstan// nang du 'jug pa rnam pa drug /de la thog mar dkyil 'khor gyi khang par zhugs pa'i slob mas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la rigs bzhi'i phyag 'tshal bar bya ste/ shar phyogs nas mi bskyod pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ pus mo gnyis sa la btsugs nas rdo rje thal mo spyi bor sbyar la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dzo pas+tha na ya āt+mā naṃ nir+ya ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa a dhiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ/ zhes brjod nas spyi bo sa la gtugs pa'i phyag bya'o// de nas lho phyogs nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe ka ya āt+mā naṃ nir+ya ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ zhes brjod nas dpral ba sa la gtugs pa'i phyag bya'o// de nas nub phyogs nas 'od dpag med kyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas thal mo dpral bar sbyar la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra brta na ya āt+mā naṃ nir+ya ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharma tsakra pra brta ya māṃ/ zhes brjod nas kha sa la gtugs pa'i phyag bya'o// de nas byang phyogs nas don yod grub pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma ṇe āt+mā naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karma ku ru māṃ/ zhes brjod nas mgo sa la gtugs pa'i phyag bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la phyogs te 'dug pa la sta gon gyi skabs ltar rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub kyi sems dang*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa rgyas par sbyin par bya ste/

slob dpon gyis nang du chud par byas nas/ snga ma bzhin du sdom pa 'dzin du bcug la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// yang na/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// 'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang*// sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// zhes lan gsum brjod pa tsam gyis byang chub kyi sems sbyin no// de ltar sbyin pa'i sdom pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems mi nyams par bsrung du gzhug pa'i phyir/ dam la gzhag par bya ste/ slob ma rnams kyis rdo rje bsdams pa/ gung mo gnyis mnyam par brkyang bas me tog gi phreng ba bzung ba/ rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya bcings nas sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod du bcug la/ slob dpon gyis kyang phyag rgya de nyid slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag cing*/ oṃ satwa badz+ri ni a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ hūm̐/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje ye shes ngas khyod la bskyed par bya ste/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar ma byed cig khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod nas phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa'o// de nas phyag rgya de nyid snying gar gtugs la/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par 'gyur// oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐/ gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes brjod nas yang phyag rgya de nyid kyis spyi bor gtugs la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na/ 'dis khyod kyi mgo 'gems par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod pa ni nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa'o// de nas thod par gnas pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu la/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mngon par bsngags pa 'thung du bcug la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na 'grub pa yi// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs shig /oṃ badz+ra u da kaḥzhes pa brjod pa ni gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa'o// de nas slob ma'i lag pa g.yas nas bzung ba'am spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng phyin chad bu khyod kyi phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi/ ngas 'di byos shig ces brjod pa gang yin pa de bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas pa ma byed cig gal te byas na mi bde ba ma spangs par khyod dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes brjod pa ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' mnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ste/ dam la bzhag pa'o// de nas ye shes dbab pa'i phyir slob mas me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs la/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab par mdzod cig ces lan gsum du brjod du gzhug go /de nas slob ma rnams tsog pur 'dug la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya snying gar 'char bcug la/ gnyi gar gyis slob ma 'od dpag tu med par lhag par dmigs nas/ yan lag thams cad la ā'i yi ge dmar po bkod de/ lus kyi nang stong par bsgoms pa'i snying gar lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi pa/ rdo rje rtse mo gsum pas mtshan pa/ lto bar bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ 'dom du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ rkang pa'i 'og tu yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang gu gzhu bdungs pa lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ rkang pa'i mthil du dzhaiṃ dmar po me'i rang bzhin/ snying gi nang du hūm̐ sngon po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ spyi bor ha dkar po rnams dmigs la/ 'og gi rlung g.yos pas dzhaiṃ gnyis po me sbar ba'i me lce 'bar ba rkang pa'i nang nas song ste/

'dom gyi me'i dkyil 'khor dang 'dres nas cher 'bar bas lus thams cad yongs su gang bas/ sdig pa dang rnam par rtog pa thams cad bsregs nas/ chu dang sa'i dkyil 'khor yang bskol zhing bsregs te/ hūm̐ dang ha dang āḥlas 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rgyud bskul bas char chen po ltar babs te/ ro gcig tu gyur pas/ lus ngag yid gsum sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsgyur bar bsams nas/ slob dpon gyis/ khyod kyis dam tshig rdo rje 'di// rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bshad de// rdo rje ye shes bla med 'di// de ring nges par 'bab par 'gyur// zhes brjod nas gu gul gyis bdug cing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ya aḥ.aḥ.aḥzhes brjod do// gal te ma phebs pa'am/ phebs kyang brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ hūm̐ a ha'i yi ge gsum rim pa bzhin du/ mi bskyod pa/ 'od dpag med/ rnam par snang mdzad yab yum du dmigs te/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras/ rigs gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bkug ste/ lha gsum gyi zhal du zhugs nas/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de/ sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems sngon po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ dkar po'i rnam pa babs pas lus thams cad khengs nas/ bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du gyur par bsams nas/ bdug pa dang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas/ ā be sha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya ra ra ra ra tsa la ya tsa la ya hūm̐ a ha dzhaiṃ/ zhes drag tu brjod cing dbab bo// phebs na 'phar ba dang*/ 'dar ba la sogs pa sku'i rtags dang*/ smra ba dang dgod pa la sogs pa gsung gi rtags dang*/ bde ba dang mi rtog pa la sogs pa thugs kyi rtags rnams 'byung ngo*// ma phebs na lan gsum du bskyar cing*/ des kyang ma phebs na re zhig dor bar bya'o// gal te gsung phebs na de'i tshe/ lce la a bkod nas dge ba dang*/

mi dge ba smros shig ces brjod na/ ma 'ongs pa'i legs nyes lung ston par 'gyur ro// de nas spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod pas phebs pa brtan par bya'o// ye shes dbab pa'o// de nas me tog dor bar bya ba'i phyir/ slob mas bla ma la phyag dang me tog phul ba sngon du 'gro bas/ rdo rje sems ma'i phyag rgyas me tog gi phreng ba bzung nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su langs nas 'khod pa la/ ltas brtag pa'i phyir nam mkha'i kha dog dri ste/ dkar po snang ba zhi ba/ ser po rgyas pa/ dmar po dbang*/ nag po mngon spyod/ ljang gu dang khra bos las sna tshogs 'grub par lung bstan la/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'di skad ces/ yang dag dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi// bsod nams ji bzhin lha rnams kyi// rigs kyi rim pa de bzhin shog /ji ltar 'di ni 'grub 'gyur ba'i// gang gi rigs kyi snod gyur dang*// ji lta'i bsod nams mthu yod pa// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces bden pa'i stobs lan gsum brjod la/ dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir lha sum cu so gnyis bzhugs pa thams cad kyang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa gcig gi ye shes kyi rnam par 'phrul pa yin pa'i phyir bzang ngan gyi rnam rtog mi bya'o// zhes bsgos la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ sha shwa to me bha wa/ hṛ da yaṃ me a dhi tiṣ+ṭhā sarba sid+dhiṃ me pra yats+tsha hūm̐ ha ha ha ha hoḥ.oṃ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ pra tīts+tsha ku su ma añja li nā tha hoḥ zhes brjod do// dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su dor nas/ gang la phog pa de'i rigs su shes par bya zhing*/ de'i gnas kyis dngos grub kyi mtshan ma shes par bya'o// gtsug tor la phog pas mchog gi dngos grub dang*/ zhal la sngags kyi dngos grub dang*/ sku la phog pas grub pa brgyad dang*/ sku dang nye bas dngos grub myur zhing*/

ring bas ring la/ gnyis kyi bar du lhung na gang nye ba'i phyogs su bsdu zhing*/ gal te de dag la ma phog na lan gsum gyi bar du bskyar ro// gsum pa la'ang ma phog na skal ba med pa'i phyir/ phyir btang ngo*// skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la me tog de nyid kyis dbang bskur bar bsam zhing*/ lha de'i sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i pra ti grih+na swa mi maṃ sa s+t+waṃ ma hā ba laṃ/ zhes brjod nas mgo la bcing ngo*// me tog dor ba'o// de nas dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i phyir slob ma'i mig 'bras gnyis oṃ du bsgom du bcug la/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// he badz+ra pa sh+ya zhes brjod nas gdong g.yogs bkrol la/ dkyil 'khor 'di la ltos shig dang*// da ni dad pa rab tu skyed// khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// zhes brjod nas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas par bstan par bya'o// dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dag las/ 'dir dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid bshad pa ni/ gzhung zor yang ba la dgongs mod/ bshad pa'i skabs na dbang bskur ba'i rjes la yin te/ dbang bskur nas ni de nyid bstan// gzhan du na ni slob dpon dang*// slob ma gnyis ka dngos grub ni// shin tu ring bar 'gyur ro zhes// rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyis bstan// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// dkyil 'khor bstan pa ste/ slob ma yongs su gzhug pa'i cho ga'o// de nas dbang bskur ba ni/ dang por bum pa'i dbang yin te// gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang yin no// gsum pa shes rab ye shes te// bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no// chu dang cod paṇa rdo rje dang*// dril bu ming dang me long dang*// brtul zhugs rdo rje slob dpon dang*// rjes gnang dang ni lung bstan dang*// de bzhin du ni dbugs dbyung ba// bcu gcig bum pa'i dbang yin no// de la thog mar dkyil 'khor gyi shar ram dbang ldan du/

khrus kyi dkyil 'khor khru do'i tshad dang ldan pa/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ dkar po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ sngon po'i rtsig pa rim pa gsum dang ldan zhing*/ nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i shar nas brtsams te/ phyogs bzhir/ rdo rje/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ sna tshogs rdo rje rnams bris pa'i dbus su rnam rgyal gyi bum pa gzhag go /de nas dkyil 'khor du bcug pa'i slob ma rnams kyis phyag dang*/ maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la// mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba 'debs su bcug nas/ mdun du gnas pa la/ dkyil 'khor gyi khro bo'i sprul pa du ma 'phros pas/ slob ma'i bgegs dang byur rnams bsal bar bsam zhing*/ bgegs mthar byed kyi sngags dang*/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chus bsangs la/ byur dang skal ba ngan pa rnams til dang yungs kar la bstim pas/ g.yas phyogs nas bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya/ badz+ra satwa s+ya sarba pā paṃ da ha na ye swā hā/ zhes brjod la mer dor nas/ bgegs mthar byed kyis mngon par bsngags pa'i chu/ rdo rje khu tshur gyis blangs pas g.yon nas bskor zhing dri ma rnams bkrus par bsams la/ hūm̐ ḍa ḍi ta phaṭa/ ces brjod nas dor la sta gon gyi skabs ltar skyor chu blud pas/ slob ma'i byur dang*/ skal ba ngan pa bsal bar bya'o// de nas slob dpon dang slob ma gnyi gar gyis rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor las sprul pa'i/ dbang gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha yongs su rdzogs pa la/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams na rang bzhin gyis bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i gtos khyab pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i don du bzhugs par blta'o// de nas slob ma rnams rang gi kha nas zhugs te/

snying ga'i ye shes kyi mes bzhu nas/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar bab pa/ hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las byung ba'i mi bskyod pa yab yum du gyur ba las/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen pos zhu ba/ rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs te/ rdo rje'i lam nas 'thon pa'i bdud rtsis dbang bskur bar bsam pa ni/ nang gi ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang ngo*// de nas sbyor mtshams nas byung nas phyi'i gnas su 'khod pa'i sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ ye shes pa bstim pa la phyi'i dbang bskur bar bya ste/ rnam rgyal gyi bum pa swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang*/ nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ sems can gyi don byas nas slar 'dus te gcig tu gyur pa las/ mi bskyod rdo rje yab yum du bskyed de/ byin gyis brlabs la ye shes pa dang ro gcig par byas nas/ dbang gi lhas dbang bskur te/ rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas btab nas snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer gyis/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskul te/ zhal du zhugs nas 'od du zhu ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur pa/ dbang gi lha rigs lngas bsnams te/ slob ma rnams kyi spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba mdzad/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa'i char mngon par phab par bsam mo// 'di dag ni 'og ma rnams la'ang shes par bya'o// de nas dngos su rdo rje slob dpon gyis rnam rgyal gyi bum pa bzung nas/ slob ma khrus kyi dkyil 'khor la bzhag la/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung ste/ bkra shis kyi tshig 'di dag brjod par bya'o// bkra shis gang zhig sems can rnams kyi snying la gnas// kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog

/sems can ma lus skyed mdzad bde ba chen po ste// bkra shis des ni de ring khyed la dbang rab bskur// bkra shis gang zhig ma lus rdo rje'i rigs dang ldan// ldang ba zil mnan skye tshogs rnam par skyong mdzad pa// mi bskyod mgon po zhes byar mtshon gsol de yi ni// bkra shis des ni de ring khyed la dbang rab bskur// bkra shis gang zhig ma lus 'khor lo'i rigs dang ldan// rnam par snang mdzad 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rtag 'phrog cing*// rmongs pa zil mnan skye ba yongs su sbyong mdzad pa// bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur// bkra shis gang zhig ma lus rin chen rigs dang ldan// phongs pa'i sdug bsngal yongs su sgrol bar rab brtson zhing*// khengs pa zil mnan 'gro ba yongs su sbyong mdzad pa// bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur// bkra shis gang zhig ma lus pad+ma'i rigs dang ldan// 'jig rten dbang phyug srid pa'i drwa ba 'joms pa po// chags pa zil mnan 'gro ba rab tu sbyong mdzad pa// bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur// bkra shis gang zhig ma lus las kyi rigs dang ldan// brtse ba'i bdag nyid log par lta ba nges par spong*// de sbyong thabs ston de ni kun nas sel mdzad pa// bkra shis des ni de ring khyod la dbang rab bskur// zhes brjod nas/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas gtor zhing*/ dbang gi lha dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu gsungs par bsams nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum pa'i// gnas las byung ba nga yis sbyin// oṃ badz+ra ā dar+sha dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes brjod nas dbang bskur nas brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa a bhi ṣe ke ṇa s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa te na dri ḍho me bha wa/

sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas// de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro// zhes brjod nas dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis lus thams cad gang bas/ dri ma thams cad dag par byas nas/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ su ra te twaṃ a haṃ zhes brjod du gzhug go /de nas mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin gyi chu'i dbang thob pas/ zhe sdang sbyangs shing rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas bsgyur te me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du bya'o zhes rtogs pa bskyed par bya'o// de nas cod paṇa gyi dbang bskur ba'i phyir/ gong du bstan pa dang mtshungs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang dang ldan pas/ swa las slob ma rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum du bskyed cing*/ mngon par 'du byas pa'i dbu rgyan rdo rje slob dpon gyis bzung la/ chags pa chen po bde ba che// rdo rje chen po nor che ba// shes rab chen po ye shes che// rdo rje sems dpa' deng bdag bsgrubs// sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje che// dngos grub kun gyi bde ster ba// kun gyi dbang bskur kun don du// rdo rje'i dbang phyug bla na med// e ma ho/ dang po'i sangs rgyas don dam sku can rgyal// thar pa nor chos 'dod pa ster mdzad rgyal// ye shes lnga dang dga' ldan rang bzhin rgyal// mgon po bde chen phyag na rdo rje rgyal// zhes bya ba'i dbyangs brjod nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rgyal srid che// dbu rgyan rin chen dam pa ste// rin chen kun gyi mchog 'gro bas// rdzogs sangs rgyas su dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra sa ma ta dz+nyā na rat+na mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñca/ zhes brjod nas dbu rgyan bcings la/ brtan par bya ba'i phyir slob dpon gyis slob ma'i spyi gtsug tu/ rdo rje thal sbyar mthe bo dag /dpa' bo'i skyil krung nyid du bskum// bar ma mchog gi yan lag kyang*// rtse mo rtse mo mnyam par sbyar// rdo rje dbyings kyi phyag rgyar bshad// phyag rgya 'dis slob ma'i spyi bor bcings nas/

oṃ badz+ra dhā tu ī shwa ri a bhi ṣiñca aḥ zhes brjod do// rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te// lag gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa'i rgya// de yi dbus ma rtse sbyar bya// sems ma'i rdo rje phyag rgya yin// phyag rgya 'di dpral bar bcings la/ oṃ satwa badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes brjod do// phyag rgya de nyid las gung mo'i tshigs dbus ma bcag pa rna ba g.yas pa'i steng du/ bcings la/ oṃ rat+na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca trām̐/ zhes brjod do// de nyid las gung mo pad+ma'i rnam par byas la/ chos kyi rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya ltag par bcings la/ oṃ dharma badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hrīḥ zhes brjod do// de nyid las gung mo'i tshigs dang po bcag la/ las kyi rdo rje ma'i phyag rgya rna ba g.yon du bcings la/ oṃ karma badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca aḥ zhes brjod do// de nas dpral bar mnyam pa'i thal mo sbyar ba kha phye nas/ thal mo gnyis g.yas dang g.yon du brkyang ba'i tshul du bya zhing*/ badz+ra tu ṣ+ya ho/ zhes brjod nas dar dpyangs kyi dbang byin la bum pa'i chus gtor bas lus thams cad gang zhing*/ dri ma thams cad dag par byas nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan no// de nas mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rang bzhin gyi cod paṇa gyi dbang thob pas/ ser sna dang nga rgyal sbyangs shing*/ tshor ba'i phung po gnas bsgyur nas/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas so// zhes rtogs pa bskyed par bya'o// de nas rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang dang ldan pa'i āḥlas slob ma 'od dpag tu med pa yab yum du bskyed cing*/ mngon par 'du byas pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis bzung la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// mi phyed rdo rje'i 'od gsal ba// dam chos 'byung ba'i sgor gyur pa// rdo rje chos kyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ pra ti bik+ṣa ṇa dz+nyā na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/

zhes brjod nas byin la/ slob mas blangs te spyi gtsug dang mgrin par gtugs nas/ snying gar bzung ba brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la nye bar 'gyur// zhes brjod du bcug nas slob dpon gyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa twaṃ dha ra yā mi badz+ra satwa ya hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas bum pa'i chus gtor bas lus thams cad gang zhing*/ dri ma thams cad dag par byas nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan no// de nas mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin gyi rdo rje'i dbang thob pas 'dod chags sbyangs shing*/ 'du shes kyi phung po gnas bsgyur nas so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas zhes rtogs pa bskyed par bya'o// de nas dril bu'i dbang bskur ba'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang dang ldan pa'i hā las don yod grub pa yab yum du bskyed cing*/ mngon par 'du byas pa'i dril bu slob dpon gyis bzung la/ thabs dang shes rab ldan pa yis// 'gro don mnyam med byed pa dang*// mchod pa'i las kun rdzogs byed pas// rdo rje las kyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra kṛ tā nuṣ+ṭhā na dz+nyā na dhi ti a bhi ṣiñca/ zhes brjod nas byin pa slob mas blangs te dkrol bar bya'o// brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la nye bar 'gyur// zhes brjod du bcug nas/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñcā mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes brjod nas bum pa'i chus gtor bas lus thams cad gang zhing*/ dri ma thams cad dag par byas nas/ don yod grub pas dbur brgyan no// de nas mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin gyi dril bu'i dbang thob pas/ phrag dog sbyangs shing 'du byed kyi phung po gnas bsgyur nas/

bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas zhes rtogs pa bskyed par bya'o// de nas slob dpon gyis me long gi dbang gsungs pa ni/ don gyi dbang rdzogs nas ming 'dogs pa la dgongs mod/ rgyu sde thams cad las rig pa'i dbang lnga 'brel chags su 'byung ba'i phyir/ ming gi dbang bskur ba ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang dang ldan pa'i oṃ las slob ma rnam par snang mdzad yab yum du bskyed la/ spyi bor yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa'i rnam par snang mdzad yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas/ slob ma'i lus la thim par bsams nas/ rdo rje dril bus spyi gtsug tu gtugs la/ me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i rigs kyi ming gdags par bya ste/ mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi skyes pa'i ming ni/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ gnyis med rdo rje/ mi phyed rdo rje/ dga' rab rdo rje/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ zhe sdang rdo rje/ rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa rnams so// bud med kyi ming ni rdo rje mā ma kī/ rdo rje bdag med ma/ rdo rje lag pa ma/ rdo rje 'byung gnas ma la sogs pa rnams so// rnam par snang mdzad kyi rigs kyi skyes pa'i ming ni/ rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje/ gti mug rdo rje/ oṃ mdzad rdo rje/ rtag pa'i rdo rje/ sgyu 'phrul rdo rje/ shākya thub pa rdo rje la sogs pa rnams so// bud med kyi ming ni rdo rje spyan ma/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ rdo rje sgeg mo la sogs pa rnams so// rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rigs kyi skyes pa'i ming ni/ rin chen rdo rje/ yid bzhin nor bu rdo rje/ nam mkha'i rdo rje/ ser sna rdo rje/ gzi brjid rdo rje la sogs pa rnams so// bud med kyi ming ni rdo rje rin chen sgrol ma/ rdo rje do shal ma/ rdo rje 'bar ma/ rdo rje phreng ba ma la sogs pa rnams so// 'od dpag tu med pa'i rigs kyi skyes pa'i ming ni/

snang ba mtha' yas rdo rje/ spyan ras gzigs rdo rje/ 'dod chags rdo rje/ chos kyi rdo rje/ pad+ma rdo rje la sogs pa rnams so// bud med kyi ming ni rdo rje gos dkar mo// rdo rje dbyangs can ma/ rdo rje blo gros ma/ rdo rje glu ma la sogs pa rnams so// don yod grub pa'i rigs kyi skyes pa'i ming ni/ don yod rdo rje/ bde mchog rdo rje/ phrag dog rdo rje/ dam tshig rdo rje/ las kyi rdo rje la sogs pa rnams so// bud med kyi ming ni rdo rje dam tshig sgrol ma/ rdo rje sgyu 'phrul ma/ rdo rje rgod ma/ rdo rje gar ma la sogs pa rnams so// kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// oṃ su bi shud+dha dharma dhā tu dz+nyā na nā ma a bhi ṣiñca/ zhes brjod nas/ brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ oṃ badz+ra satwa twaṃ a bhi ṣiñcā mi badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa ste/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas// byang chub snying po'i bar du ni// cis kyang mi shigs mi g.yo bas// rdo rje ming du rab tu grags// zhes brjod nas bum pa'i chus gtor bas lus thams cad gang zhing*/ dri ma thams cad dag par byas nas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan no// de nas mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin gyi ming gi dbang thob pas/ gti mug sbyangs nas gzugs kyi phung po gnas bsgyur nas/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas zhes rtogs pa bskyed par bya'o/ sgra gcan 'dzin bshes gnyen gyis/ ming gi dbang mi bskyod pa dang 'brel bar gsung ba ni ye shes la dgongs mod/ dbang gi gnas skabs su sbyang gzhi sbyong ba gtso che ba'i phyir/ rnam par snang mdzad nyid rigs te/ tshul gzhan las kyang 'byung zhing*/ slob dpon gyis kyang rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin gyi ming gi dbang bskur bar gsungs so// de nas rdo rje phreng ba las/

sangs rgyas lnga ni dag pa 'di// dbang bar lnga ni thob pa'i rgyu// ma rig pa ni bsal nas ni// ye shes lnga ni thob par 'gyur// zhes brjod nas/ de'i don dbang 'di rnams sbyong gzhi chos can/ phung po lnga dang*/ nyon mongs pa lnga sbyong zhing*/ thob par bya ba rigs lnga dang*/ ye shes lnga mngon du byed pas/ rig pa'i rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga'i dbang yin pa'i phyir/ rig pa'i dbang lnga zhes bya ste/ bdag gi rgyud de bzhin gshegs par byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ snang ba thams cad kyang de'i rang bzhin du blta bar bya ste/ dngos kun gang dang gang snang ba// gtso de rang gi lhag pa'i lha// chos rnams rang bzhin rnam dag pa// sangs rgyas ye shes blta bar gyis// zhes thun mong gi rtogs pa bskyed par bya'o// de nas chos nyid de bzhin mngon du bya ba'i phyir/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin me long gi dbang bskur ba'ang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i sku phab la zhes gsungs pa ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma gzhan du blta bar mi bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das ma reg rdo rje nyid do// ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang dang ldan pa'i a las/ slob ma reg rdo rjer bskyed par bya'o// rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i phyir kha dog dkar mo/ de nas mngon par 'du byes pa'i me long slob dpon gyis bzung la/ brjod dang gzung 'dzin rnam spangs shing*// dag cing gsal la dri ma med// me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin// rang lha'i gzugs ni shes par gyis// oṃ pra ti bim+ba ā dar+sha bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca a/ zhes brjod nas/ slob ma la bstan la/ des kyang bltas nas/ chos nyid dri ma med pa me long lta bu la/ chos can gzugs brnyan dang 'dra bar shes shing*/ rang chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin du bsam du gzhug go /de nas bum pa'i chus gtor bas lus thams cad gang zhing*/ mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i dri ma thams cad sbyangs/
