rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan no// slar yang mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i me long gi dbang bskur bas/ mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i dri ma sbyangs nas/ dbyings rang bzhin gyis dag pa mngon du byas zhes rtogs pa bskyed par bya'o// de nas dbyings dang ye shes ro gcig pa thob pa'i bya ba'i phyir/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs sbyin par bya ste/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang dang ldan pa'i hūm̐ las/ slob ma rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du bskyed cing*/ mngon par 'du byas pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par sbyin zhing*/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na bsnams// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma yaṃ a nu tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ ra yā mi hiḥhi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes brjod do// des kyang blangs nas hūm̐ zhes brjod cing*/ lan gsum gsor nas/ snying gar bzung nas snying gi nang du yang rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' thugs kar rdo rje dkar po rtse mo lnga pas mtshan pa bzhugs pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rjer bsgom du bcug nas rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs kyi gsang ba 'dzin pa/ phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs 'dzin par gyur ces rtogs pa bskyed par bya'o// rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi rjes la/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs bya bar gsungs pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang brtan par bya ba la dgongs mod/ thun mong gi dbang thog mar 'byung ba'i phyir sngon du bya bar rigs so// thun mong ba slob ma'i dbang bskur ba rnams so// de nas thun mong ma yin pa rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar nas/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur che// rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la stsol// dkyil 'khor lha yi de nyid dang*// slob dpon gyi ni las rnams dang*// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*// sdom dang gsang ba bla med stsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// rtag tu slob dpon bdag 'gyur gsungs// zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab bo// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su khru gnyis dor bar/

khrus kyi dkyil 'khor dang mtshungs pa'i dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du seng ges bteg pa'i khri/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pas mtshan pa la slob ma bzhag cing*/ gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan dang*/ mchod pa'i tshogs rnams kyis yongs su bskor nas/ rdo rje slob dpon dbang gi lha dang bcas pa thams cad kyis/ slob ma rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur ba'i phyir/ gong du bstan pa ltar ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang gis/ slob ma mi bskyod rdo rjer gyur par phyung nas/ khri'i steng du 'khod pa la dam tshig gsum sbyin par bya ste/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi dam tshig tu byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdo rje bzung nas/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang sngags brjod de byin la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems ma'i dag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o zhes de kho na nyid brjod do// slob mas badz+ra hūm̐ zhes brjod cing*/ lan gsum gsor te snying gar bzung la/ rdo rje 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi dam tshig ste/ 'dis byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ bdag gi sems kyang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje'i ngo bo zhes dran du gzhug go /de nas aḥlas byung ba sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi dam tshig tu byin gyis brlabs pa'i dril bu bzung nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed// aḥzhes brjod nas byin la/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral ba// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa// srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur// zhes de kho na nyid brjod de/

slob mas badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥzhes brjod nas dkrol/ dril bu 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi dam tshig ste/ 'dis byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ bdag gi ngag kyang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo zhes dran du gzhug go /de nas slob ma'i lus skad cig gis mi bskyod rdo rje yab yum du bskyed la/ sku gsung thugs dang skye mched byin gyis brlabs nas/ ye shes pa dang ro gcig par byas nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i dam tshig tu byin gyis brlabs nas/ yid kyi lus ni brtan bya'i phyir// phyag rgya dam tshig ces su bshad// lus kun brtan par byas pas na// de phyir phyag rgya zhes su bsgrags// hūm̐ zhes brjod do// slob mas kyang rdo rje 'chang chen po yum shes rab lo bcu drug ma la 'khyud pa'i rnam pa/ 'di nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i dam tshig yin la/ 'dis byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ bdag gi lus kyang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku rdo rje'i ngo bo'o// zhes dran du gzhug go /de nas phyag rgya chen por byin gyis brlabs la/ snying po bsnyen pa sogs spyad pas// gzugs sogs 'dod pa'i dam tshig gis// gsang sngags ma tshang med par bzla// rang rig pa yi ngo bo nyid// phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa ste// rang gi lha yi sbyor ba yis// bdag dang gzhan la mchod par bya// dka' thub sdom pa mi bzad pas// bsten na mi snang mngon shes dang*// mkha' la rgyu dang lus ngag yid// las byung dngos grub 'grub mi 'gyur// de bas sangs rgyas sems dpa' mchog /sngags kyi spyod mchog spyad pa rnams// 'dod pa thams cad bsten pa yis// chos kyi yi ge mchog brnyes so// bde dang sdug bsngal de dag min// 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams bsten// ye shes don gnyer 'dod chags can// sbyor bas bsgrubs na myur du 'grub// sku gsung thugs ni yang dag 'grub// gang gzhan dman par bshad pa ni// sngags kyi bzlas pas 'grub 'gyur bas// sku gsung thugs ni bsgoms pas so// zhes phyag rgya'i dam tshig brjod nas/

yang snga ma bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa'i bum pa de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bsnams nas dbang bskur/ de'i tshe rig ma dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo dang lha mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu dang*/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ bgegs bskrad pa dang*/ mchod pa'i char phab par bsams la/ dngos su slob dpon gyis/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la// zhes pa la sogs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ sngags brjod cing bum pa'i chus gtor ro// las kyi rdo rje dang slob dpon rnams kyis mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bya'o// dbang gi chu rgyun des lus thams cad gang bas/ dri ma thams cad sbyangs nas/ spyi bor rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de nas/ zla ba'i 'od can ye shes sku lnga rgyal ba'i cod paṇa 'dzin pa pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs// gdug pa rnams ni 'dul ba'i don du srid gsum 'dul mdzad pa sdigs pa'i de nyid rdo rje can// sangs rgyas rnams ni bskul phyir de kho na nyid so so sgrogs pa'i chos nyid dril bu 'khrol// dngos po kun gyi ngo bo ma lus stong pa'i bcom ldan gang yin de ni rgyal gyur cig /oṃ su pra ti badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod nas slob ma'i spyi bor me tog phreng ba bzhag go /brtan par bya ba'i phyir slob dpon gyis yi ge brgya pa brjod pa'i rjes su slob mas kyang bzla bar bya'o// de ltar rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang thob pas de kho na nyid bstan pa'i snod du gyur pas/ de kho na nyid bstan par bya ste/ thog mar dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi tshad khru bcu gnyis ni rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bcu gnyis so// tshangs pa'i gnas zhi rnam par dag pa zur bzhi'o// 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rnam par dag pa ngos bzhi'o// dran pa nye bar gzhag pa zhi rnam par dag pa ni shar gyi sgo'o// yang dag par spong ba bzhi rnam par dag pa ni lho'i sgo'o// rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi rnam par dag pa ni nub kyi sgo'o// dbang po lnga dang stobs lnga rnam par dag pa ni byang gi sgo'o// bsam gtan bzhi rnam par dag pa ni sgo bzhi'i to ra ṇa'o// rnam par thar pa brgyad rnam par dag pa ni ka ba brgyad do// rdo rje theg pa'i sgo nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas na rdo rje'i thig dang ldan pa'o// tshon lnga ni sangs rgyas lnga'i rang bzhin no// yang dag pa'i ye shes kyis kun nas bskor ba'i phyir/

dbus kyi pho brang rdo rje'i phreng ba zlum pos bskor ba'o// ting nge 'dzin bzhi dag pa ni kha khyer ro// gzungs rnam pa bzhi rnam par dag pa ni lha mo'i tshogs mchod pas phyag brel ba rnams so// drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pas brgyan pa ni byang chub kyi yan lag bdun no// rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang dril bus mtshan pa ni gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis so// thabs kyi bye brag ma 'dres par so sor snang ba ni bar bar gyi tshon sna gcig pa'o// spos dang me tog la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i bye brag dang*/ gar dang dbyangs la sogs pa'i bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor bla na med pa'i mchod pa nyams dga' ba'o// gser gyi bum pa brgyad kyis brgyan pa ni tshogs rnam pa gnyis rdzogs pa'o// bde ba chen po'i rnam par thar pa'i gzhal yas khang yin pas na gzhal yas khang ngo*// dkyil ni snying po'i don to// 'khor ni thob pa'i don to// des na dkyil 'khor ro// de nas lha'i de kho na nyid ni gzugs dang*/ tshor ba dang*/ 'du shes dang*/ 'du byed dang*/ rnam par shes pa lnga ni/ me long lta bu dang*/ mnyam pa nyid dang*/ so sor rtog pa dang*/ bya ba grub pa dang*/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te/ rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan dang*/ 'od dpag tu med pa dang*/ don yod grub pa dang*/ mi bskyod pa ste/ go rim bzhin du rnam par dag pa'o// sa dang chu dang me dang rlung gi khams ni/ spyan ma dang*/ mā ma kī dang*/ gos dkar mo dang*/ sgrol ma ste/ go rim bzhin du rnam par dag pa yin la/ de nyid byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ dga' ba dang*/ btang snyoms bzhi'i rang bzhin yin no// gzugs dang*/ sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ reg bya ni/ gzugs rdo rje dang*/ sgra rdo rje dang*/ dri rdo rje dang*/ ro rdo rje dang*/ reg bya rdo rje ste/ go rim bzhin du rnam par dag pa yin no// de nyid thabs dang*/ stobs dang*/

smon lam dang*/ ye shes dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin can no// mig dang*/ rna ba dang*/ sna dang*/ lce dang*/ lus dang*/ yid kyi dbang po dang*/ chos dang nam mkha' ni/ sa'i snying po dang*/ phyag na rdo rje dang*/ nam mkha'i snying po dang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug dang*/ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sel ba dang*/ 'jam dpal dang*/ byams pa dang*/ kun tu bzang po ste go rim bzhin du rnam par dag pa yin te/ gtso bo'i yon tan gyi cha'i ye shes bzhi'i rang bzhin no// ser sna dang*/ mi snyan pa dang*/ don dang mi mthun pa dang*/ don mi dpyod pa ni/ gshin rje gshed dang*/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang*/ rta mgrin dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ste/ go rim bzhin du rnam par dag pa yin te/ sbyin pa dang*/ snyan par smra ba dang*/ don mthun pa dang*/ don spyod pa'i rang bzhin can yin no// mig la sogs pa'i rnam par shes pa drug ni/ mi g.yo mgon po dang*/ 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang*/ dbyug pa sngon po can dang*/ stobs po che dang*/ gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba dang*/ gnod mdzes te/ go rim bzhin du dag pa yin no// de dag kyang rang rang gi gtso bo'i ye shes lhun gyis grub pa la nges par zad pa dang*/ mi skye ba'i ye shes kyi yon tan du bstan to// 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa la sogs pa'i chos thams cad gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du ro gcig pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po ste/ lha thams cad kyi ngo bor bstan to// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi lus la rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gnas pa bshad de/ lus ni gzhal yas khang du gyur// sangs rgyas kun gyis yang dag brten// zur bzhi pa ni mdun rgyab dang*// g.yas dang g.yon gyi dbye bas so// steng dang 'og sgo'i dbye ba yis// sgo bzhi zhes ni bshad pa yin// sna yi rtse mo'i dbyibs kyis ni// rta babs bzhir ni brjod par bya// drwa ba rgyu mar yang dag bshad// rgyus par gyur par drwa ba phyed// kha ni zla ba phyed pa dang*// bum pa lto bar yang dag bshad// rje ngar brla dpung lag ngar ni// ka ba brgyad du yang dag bshad// mig gi rnam shes me long sogs// sgra yi rnam shes ba dan dang*// sna yi rnam shes me tog 'phyar// rin chen pha gu lce rnam shes// lus kyi rnam shes dar 'phan dang*// yid kyi rnam shes ri dwags so// mig ni 'khor lo mtshan ma dang*// rna ba kun nas rdo rje rnams// sna ni ba dan dag tu bshad// lce ni dril bu ru ni gsungs// rnga yab la sogs rnam dag pa// lus kyi tshogs zhes bya bar bshad// yid ni dbus kyi pad+mar gsungs// rnam rtog rlung ni yang dag brten// ye shes lnga ni rnam dag pa// re kha lngar ni yang dag brjod// phung po lnga ni yang dag lnga// rnam dag kha dog lnga ni byed// ces bya ba dang*/

rdo rje slob dpon lus 'di la// rgyal ba'i sku ni rim bzhin gnas// dang po gzugs kyi phung po ni// sku yi rdo rje yang dag bzhugs// de bzhin nam mkha'i rdo rje ni// tshor ba yi ni phung por bzhugs// bcom ldan gsung gi rdo rje ni// 'du shes kyi ni phung por bzhugs// las rnam kun gyi rdo rje ni// 'du byed kyi ni phung por bzhugs// bcom ldan thugs kyi rdo rje ni// rnam shes phung por yang dag bzhugs// yang*/ 'di yi sha sogs sa khams la// bcom ldan 'das yum spyan ma bzhugs// khrag sogs chu yi khams la ni// bcom ldan 'das yum mā ma bzhugs// dro ba la sogs me khams la// bcom ldan 'das yum gos dkar bzhugs// bskyod pa la sogs rlung khams la// bcom ldan 'das yum sgrol ma bzhugs// de mig dbang po gnyis la ni// de bzhin gshegs pa sa snying po// de yi rna ba'i dbang gnyis la// bde gshegs phyag na rdo rje'o// de yi sna bug gnyis la ni// de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha'i mdzod// de yi lce dbang la bzhugs pa// de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten dbang*// de yi yid kyi dbang po la// de bzhin gshegs pa 'jam dbyangs bzhugs// khams bzhi'i rang bzhin gong bu ni// lus zhes bya bar btags pa la// sgrib pa thams cad rnam sel ba// de bzhin gshegs pa de bzhugs so// lus kyi tshigs ni thams cad la// de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu bzang*// lus kyi rtsa rgyus thams cad la// de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa'o// lag pa g.yas pa'i rtsa bar ni// de bzhin gshegs pa gshin rje gshed// lag pa g.yon pa'i rtsa bar ni// bde gshegs gzhan gyis mi thub pa// kha yi pad+mar bzhugs pa ni// de bzhin gshegs pa rta mgrin no// gsang ba'i gnas su bzhugs pa ni// de bzhin gshegs pa bdud rtsi 'khyil// dpung pa g.yas par bzhugs pa ni// de bzhin gshegs pa mi g.yo mgon// dpung pa g.yon par bzhugs pa ni// de bzhin gshegs pa 'dod pa'i rgyal// pus mo g.yas par bzhugs pa ni// de bzhin gshegs pa dbyig pa sngo// pus mo g.yon par bzhugs pa ni// de bzhin gshegs pa stobs po che// gong gi spyi gtsug steng bzhugs pa// de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor los sgyur// rkang pa'i 'og tu bzhugs pa ni// de bzhin gshegs pa gnod mdzes te// lus ni 'di nyid kun la 'dir// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bzhugs// zhes bya ba dang*/

gzugs ni gzugs kyi rdo rje dang*// sgra ni sgra yi rdo rje ste// dri ni dri yi rdo rje ste// ro ni ro yi rdo rjer bshad// reg bya reg bya'i rdo rje ste// chos ni chos dbyings dbang phyug ma// zhes brjod pa ni rdo rje slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid do// gzhal yas khang gi de kho na nyid kyis lam gyi chos dang*/ lha'i de kho na nyid kyis 'bras bu'i chos mtshon zhing*/ thams cad kyang rdo rje slob dpon la tshang la/ ji ltar rdo rje slob dpon la tshang ba de bzhin du/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bskur ba thob pa'i slob ma khyed rnams la'ang tshang ngo*// zhes rgyas par bshad par bya ste/ de kho na nyid do// de nas rjes su gnang ba sbyin par bya ste/ sngags dang slob dpon bya ba dang*// thur ma me long dril bu dang*// mda' gzhu me long ral gri ste// sems can don byed rjes gnang drug /gnyis ka'i don dang chos 'chad pa'i// rjes su gnang ba rnam pa lnga// de la thog mar sngags kyi rjes su gnang ba ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi thugs kar gnas pa'i sngags las/ sngags kyi phreng ba gnyis pa 'thon nas/ slob ma'i snying gi nang du bkod pa gnyi gar gyis bsam zhing*/ gtso bo'i snying po lan gsum rjes su bzlas pa'i mthar/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes brjod du gzhug bla mas kyang*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// zhes brjod nas/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// snying po yi ni ye shes mchog /sangs rgyas thams cad bsdus pa ni// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// zhes brjod do// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ phreng ba la sogs dbang rnams kyi// dbang bskur nga yis byin pa yis// sdig pa thams cad rnam spangs te// sangs rgyas kun gyi mdun du gnas// da ni dkyil 'khor slob dpon te// sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin par 'gyur// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// lha rnams kyis kyang mthun par bsngags// khyod ni bdud las rnam rgyal te// sangs rgyas thams cad thob par 'gyur// seng ge'i spyod pa legs spyad pas// khyod kyis sems can don rnams byos// chos rnams kun la ser sna dang*// sems can rnams la mi phan gang*// nyam nga shin tu che na yang*// bu khyod kyis ni de mi bya// 'di la the tshom mi bya ste// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul gyi mchog

/mnyam med khyod kyis bsgrag par bya// dkyil 'khor legs par bri bya ste// slob ma yongs su bsdu bar gyis// dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis su// slob ma rnams la dbang yang bskur// brtul zhugs brtan pas 'jig rten dang*// 'jig rten 'das pa'i dngos grub sgrubs// de nyid rig pa'i sems kyis ni// dngos grub de rnams thams cad 'byung*// chos kyi dbyings kyi byin brlabs dang*// dam tshig rnams kyang bskyang ba dang*// khyod rtag bla ma la gus pa// de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la// phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes brjod// des na byas pa gzo ba yi// sangs rgyas rnams kyang khyod la bsrung*// zhes brjod do// de nas sems can gyi don bya ba'i rjes su gnang ba la/ thog mar ma rig pa'i ling thog sel ba'i phyir/ thur ma'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ gser ram dngul las byas pa'i thur ma la/ dkyil 'khor gyi rdul tshon bsgos pas mig dbye ba'i tshul du bya zhing*/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten ling thog bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal// oṃ badz+ra ni tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥpraṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas gang la don bya ba'i yul sems can dang*/ chos thams cad gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du shes par bya ba'i phyir/ me long gi rjes su gnang ba ni/ a yis mngon par bsngags pa me long slob ma la sbyin zhing*/ bltar bcug la/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu byung*// ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes kyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// skyob pa rnams kyi sras su skye// zhes brjod do// don yon grub pa'i dbang gi rjes la/ thur ma dang me long gi rjes gnang bya bar bshad pa ni/

las kyi rigs su 'du bar dgongs nas phyogs gcig tu bsdebs mod/ dkyil 'khor cho ga gzhan dang mthun par 'di nyid du bya bar rigs te/ rjes su gnang ba'i skabs yin pa'i phyir ro// de nas kun rdzob rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gzugs brnyan dang mtshungs pa nyid kyis/ don dam pa rang bzhin med pa nam mkha' dang 'dra bar shes par bya ba'i phyir/ dril bu'i rjes su gnang ba ni aḥyis mngon par bsngags pa'i dril bu byin la/ 'khrol du bcug la/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med// nam mkha' dag dang mnyam ldan pas// kun kyang mnyam pa nyid du gsal// zhes brjod do// de nas sems can gyi don byed pa'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs bdag la chags pa/ nyan thos kyi sems dang*/ thar pa la rgyab kyis phyogs pa mu stegs kyi sems dang*/ 'gro ba la zhe sdang ba bdud kyi sems sun dbyung ba'i phyir/ slob ma rdo rje chags pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa la/ mda' dang gzhu byin nas/ phyogs bcur 'phen pa'i tshul byed du bcug la/ ho de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par byos shig ces brjod do// de nas sems can gyi don la mthu dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ rang gi sems rnam par dag pa la rdo rje sems dpa' 'jug par 'gyur ro// zhes bstan pa'i don du/ slar yang me long gi rjes su gnang ba ni/ snga ma bzhin du byin gyis brlabs pa'i me long byin la bltar bcug nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long ltar// bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs// gang yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems 'di yin par shes par gyis shig ces brjod do// de nas phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i spyod pas sems can gyi don byed pa'i phyir/ ral gri'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ khaṃ gis mngon par bsngags pa'i ral gri byin la/ 'debs pa'i tshul byed du gzhug cing*/ 'di kun bzang spyod brtul zhugs te// bsam pa sna tshogs rnam dag byed// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// sems can kun gyi don ni byos// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta khaḍ+ga dha ra twaṃ/

zhes brjod nas/ slob mas dha ra yā mi hūm̐/ zhes brjod du gzhug go /de nas rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don bsgrub pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ ngo bo nyid kyis sems can rnams// ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba// de lta de ltar chags la sogs// gtsang bas sems can don bya'o// nyin re zhing ni thun bzhi ru// ting 'dzin gsum gyi sbyor ldan par// gyur nas thun mong cig shos kyi// dngos grub thob pa'ang 'grub par bya// mi snang ba ni stong yin te// mngon shes ldan pa stong gnyis yin// rig pa 'dzin pa stong gsum ste// rdo rje can gyis 'gro kun bdag /zhi dang rgyas la sogs gang dang*// de las gzhan pa ci 'dod pa// 'khor la rjes mnyam sbyor ba yis// bsgrubs na myur du 'grub par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa rgyud nyan pa dang*/ 'chad pa dang*/ mchog dang thun mong bsgrub pa dang*/ zhi ba la sogs pas sems can gyi don byed pa ste/ de dag thams cad byed par rjes su gnang ba yin no// de nas chos bshad pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ 'khor lo bris pa'i steng du slob ma bzhag nas lag tu 'khor lo byin la/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten kun la thams cad du// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu skor// dza ya dza ya sarba ta thā ga ta/ a dhi pa ti pra brta ya/ dharma tsakraṃ zhes brjod do// de nas rin po che byin la/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten kun la thams cad du// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i// sangs rgyas rin chen rab tu ston// oṃ badz+ra rat+na sarba dharmā bi shud+dha dz+nyā na a bhi ṣe ke pra bha/ oṃ oṃ oṃ zhes brjod do// de nas pad+ma byin la/ sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten kun la thams cad du// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba// 'dod chags dag pa rab tu ston// oṃ badz+ra dharma sarba dharmā bi shud+dha dz+nyā na rā ga pad+ma da la swa bhā wa hrīḥ.āḥzhes brjod do// de nas rdo rje byin la/

sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten kun la thams cad du// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba// rdo rje mchod pa rab tu skor// oṃ badz+ra karma sarba dharmā bi shud+dha dz+nyā na sarba pū dza swa bhā wa aḥzhes brjod nas/ khyod kyis rigs lnga dang 'brel ba'i chos gang dang gang gis 'dul bar 'gyur ba/ de dang de'i chos kyi 'khor lo skor bar gyis shig ces brjod do// rjes su gnang ba'o// //de nas lung bstan pa'i phyir/ da ltar sangs rgyas rigs su 'jug /khyod kyis bdag la lung bstan gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba 'debs su bcug la/ slob dpon gyis chos gos bgos nas/ shākya thub pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgyas slob ma'i spyi bor gtugs la/ oṃ nga yis 'di ltar lung bstan te// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa mchog ni bsgrub pa'i phyir// srid pa'i ngan 'gro nyid las bton// kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhur+bhu wa swaḥ 'di yis dbang bskur gyur pa yis/ sngags pa 'gro ba kun gyi bdag bla na med pa'i byang chub tu/ bde gshegs kyis kyang lung bstan mdzad// ces brjod do// de nas dbugs dbyung ba'i phyir/ bla ma'i zhal snga las ni skyes// mgon po yang dag bdag dbugs phyung*// zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su bcug la/ slob dpon gyis 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya bstan la/ mchog gsang dkyil 'khor dam pa 'di// mthong ba'am ni zhugs gyur pa// sdig kun las ni nges grol bar// khyed rnams deng nyid legs par gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di la ni// slar khyod 'chi ba yod min te// mi thub pa dang mi gsod pas// cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis// srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir// srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das// srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir// ston pa'i mchog tu 'gyur ba yin// srid pa rtag tu dngos grub bo// dam tshig sdom pa 'grub pa 'di// khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya// sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs// dam pa rtag pa'i bka' yin no// byang chub sems ni gtang mi bya// phyag na rdo rje gang yin pa'o// gang gis bskyed pa tsam gyis ni// sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med// dam pa'i chos ni mi spang zhing*// nam yang dor bar mi bya'o// mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis// slob dpon la ni gang smod pa// tshul chen bstan par mi bya'o// bdag nyid yongs su spangs nas ni// dka' thub kyis ni ma gdungs shing*// ci bde bar ni bde bar zung*// 'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya rnams// nam yang yongs su mi dor zhing*// slob dpon smad par mi bya'o// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra// sangs rgyas kun mtshungs bla ma yi// slob dpon la ni gang smod pa// de ni sangs rgyas kun smod pas// rtag tu sdug bsngal 'thob 'gyur te// rims dang dgra dang dug dang nad// mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gtses pa dang*// gdon dang log 'dren gtum po yis// bsad nas sems can dmyal bar ltung*// de bas nan tan thams cad kyis// rdo rje slob dpon blo gros che// dge ba rab tu mi sbyongs pa// nam yang smad par mi bya'o// bla ma la ni gus pas yon// rjes su mthun pas sbyin par bya// des ni rims sogs gnod pa rnams// phyir zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// rtag tu rang gi dam tshig bsrung*// rtag tu de bzhin gshegs par mchod// rtag tu bla ma la yang dbul// 'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang 'dra// de byin sangs rgyas thams cad la// rtag tu byin pa nyid du 'gyur// de byin bsod nams tshogs yin te// tshogs las dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur// gang phyir 'dir ni bder gnas pas// deng khyed skye ba 'bras bur bcas// lha dang dam tshig mnyam pa ru// deng khyod 'gyur bar the tshom med// sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin bcas pa// kun gyi deng khyod dbang bskur bas// khams gsum gyi ni rgyal po che// rgyal po'i bdag pos bstan pa yin// de ni bdud las rnam rgyal te// grong khyer mchog tu rab tu zhugs// khyed rnams kyis ni sangs rgyas nyid// de nyid thob par the tshom med// de ltar yid ni rab dang rdo rje nyid du gyis// rang gi dam tshig mi bzad bde skyed bsten par gyis// des ni 'gro la myur ba de rdo rje sems dpa' dang*// rab tu mnyam zhing rtag pa nyid du rtogs par gyis// zhes brjod pa ni/

lam dang 'bras bu'i dus kyi dbugs dbyung ba ste/ de nyid gzengs bstod par yang 'gyur ro// lung bstan pa dang dbugs dbyung ba rdo rje phreng ba nas 'byung ba ltar/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi thog mar bya ba'am/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi gzhung ltar dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i rjes la byas kyang 'gal ba med mod/ dkyil 'khor cho ga gzhan dang mthun par 'di nyid du byas na mdzes par rtogs so// de nas mjug gi cho ga ni/ slob mas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// zhes dam tshig bsdus te khas blangs nas ci 'byor ba'i yon phul nas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran tu// khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyod kyis slob mar gzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod du bcug nas/ slob dpon gyis/ khyod kyis rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor chen por/ bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob pas lus kyi dri ma dag par byas nas/ bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ sprul pa'i sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so// zhes brda sprad par bya'o// bum pa'i dbang ngo*// //de nas gsang ba'i dbang gi don du/ slob ma rnam par snang mdzad kyi nga rgyal 'dzin pas/ bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur dmigs la/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar la/ rdo rje sems khyod sangs rgyas rnams kyi bde ba bsgrub pa ste// rnam dag byang chub sems dpa' rgyal chen sras su gyur pa rnams// yun ring stong pa nyid bsgoms pas ni rab tu gdungs pa la// dga' ba yid 'ong bde ba chen po nyid kyis mnyes par mdzod// kye ho 'dod chags de ni dri med kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa ste// dag pa'i 'dod chags rdo rje dam tshig la ni phye mdzad nas// dga' ba rnam pa drug po spyod pas shin tu gdungs pa la// rab tu dgyes dbang 'dod pa'i bde ba nyid kyis 'joms par mdzod// pad+ma'i dbus nas rin chen 'bar ba rab phyung ste// ma lus rgyal ba rnams kyi sku ni skams pa la// rnam dag rdo rje las ni byung ba'i ye shes chu// dri med rin chen char gyis spyi bor dbang bskur gsol// mnyam dang mi mnyam 'dod chags tshul dag pas// pad+ma'i gnas su rdo rje mdzod gtong pa'i// sna tshogs sems dpa' sems can byin rlob 'gyur// sbyor ba gzhan min ma thogs bshad par gsol// rdo rje sems khyod dbang mchog bde ba byed pa yi// rdo rje pad+ma phye ba'i tshul gyis sbyor mdzad do// rgyal ba kun gyi gzugs kyi sku ni rab ston nas// thams cad bde 'grub nyid kyis bdag la dgyes par mdzod// ces lan gsum du gsol btab nas/

slob ma'i gdong mngon par g.yogs te/ yi ge gsum brjod cing bdud rtsis bsang gtor bya'o// de nas slob dpon gyis bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rje'am/ rin chen rdo rjer gsal bar dmigs pa dang*/ rig ma reg rdo rjer bskyed pa'i mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas/ snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i bde ba chen po'i sgras phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs zhal du zhugs nas rjes su chags pa'i mes rab tu bzhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems rdo rje nor bu'i rtser phab ste/ bde ba chen pos lus kyi lha rnams mnyes par byas la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod nas phaṭa kyi sgras yum gyi mkhar mngon par phab pa/ rgan po dang ming med kyis blangs la/ slob ma'i khar sbyin zhing*/ kun rdzob byang chub sems gang yin// gsang ba de yi dbang bskur bya// de ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dam tshig chen po rmad byung ba// khams lnga las byung bcud kyis len// bde ba chen po myang bar gyis// 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang ba yis// rgyal sras ji ltar dbang bskur ltar// byang chub sems kyi chu yis ni// bu khyod de bzhin dbang bskur bya// zhes brjod nas/ slob mas myangs te mid nas/ lus thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyis yongs su gang bas/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam par rtog pa thams cad 'gags nas/ gsung rnam par dag pa 'od dpag tu med pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsgom du bcug nas/ a ho ma hā su kha zhes brjod du gzhug go /de nas gdong g.yogs pa phye la bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob pas/ ngag gi dri ma dag par byas nas/ bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so// zhes brdar sprad nas/ sgyu ma'i dpe bcu gnyis kyis mtshon pa/

kun rdzob kyi bden pa la slob du gzhug go /gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// //de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du/ slob ma 'od dpag tu med pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pas/ bla ma chos kyi skur dmigs pa la phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar la/ khong stong khyod kyi sku la med// sha dang rus pa khrag med kyang*// nam mkha' la ni 'ja' tshon ltar// khyod kyi sku ni ston par mdzad// sku la snyun med mi gtsang med// bkres dang skom pa 'byung med kyang*// khyod ni 'jig rten rjes 'jug phyir// 'jig rten bya ba ston par mdzad// chu zla bzhin du gzung du med// chos rnams kun la gnas pa med// nga rgyal med cing rmongs mi mnga'// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gshegs dang bzhugs dang de bzhin gzims// spyod lam dag ni thams cad du// khyod ni rtag tu mnyam 'jog pa// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// rdzu 'phrul che dgu rnam 'phrul zhing*// sna tshogs min la snyoms 'jug pa// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khams gsum las ni rnam grol zhing*// nam mkha' dang ni mnyam 'gyur ba// 'dod pa rnams kyis ma gos pa// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// phung po rnams dang khams rnams dang*// skye mched rnams la mi brten cing*// phyin ci log las rnam grol ba// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam rtog med cing kun rtog med// thugs ni rab tu mi gnas pa// bsam gyis mi khyab pa yi thugs// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// ji ltar nam mkha' gnas med cing*// spros med gos pa med pa ltar// mkha' dang mnyam pa'i thugs mnga' ba// dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bya bas bstod nas/ thams cad stong pa'i bdag nyid can// mngon par byang chub blta bar 'tshal// las dang skye las rnam grol zhing*// snang ba gsum po spang ba yi// byang chub mngon par mthong ba ni// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes che// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// rdo rje ye shes bla na med// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// thog mtha' med cing zhi ba med// nyon mongs thams cad rnam sbyang zhing*// lus dang ngag dang sems sbyor ba// rdo rje chen po bdag 'tshal lo// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab nas/

snga ma bzhin du slob ma'i gdong g.yogs te bsang gtor byas la/ skad cig gis mi bskyod rdo rje 'am/ rin chen rdo rjer bsgom du gzhug go /dam tshig sdom pa'i skal ldan pa// na tshod bcu gnyis lon pa'am// yang na lo ni bcu drug ste// nyi shu lon yang mdzes ma ni// zhes bya ba'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rig ma reg rdo rjer bskyed nas/ khyod kyis dga' ma 'di zung shig /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis dgongs// 'khor lo'i rim pa'i sbyor ba yis// bde ba dam pa myong bar gyis// srid pa gsum ni rigs 'di las// gzhan pa'i thabs kyis sangs rgyas min// des na 'di yang nam du yang*// khyod kyis 'bral bar ma byed cig /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med// rmongs pa gang zhig 'di spong ba// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// ces brjod nas sbyin par bya'o// des kyang gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan nas/ bshang gci la sogs za ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin sha /rtag par bud med mchog gus pas// bha ga'i pad+mor 'o byed pa// ji ltar spro bar byed dam ci// ji ltar dga' ba smros shig bu// zhes dris pa'i lan du/ bshang gci bdud rtsi bza' bya ba// bud med rtag gus cis mi bgyid// gsang ba'i pad+mor 'o byed pa// lha mo bdag ni cis mi spro// zhes lan 'debs su bcug pas/ de mnyes nas 'di skad du/ e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di// bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas// gang zhig cho ga bzhin bsten pa// de yi mdun na nga gnas te// sangs rgyas brnyan pa la sogs pa// pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin gyis// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs// twaṃ bhañja mo k+ṣa hoḥzhes brjod nas slob ma'i pang du byon pa dang*/ gnyis ka'i lus la sangs rgyas lnga'i ngo bo yi ge 'bru lnga bkod de/ mkha' dang gsang ba byin gyis brlabs nas/

man ngag las 'byung ba'i thabs kyi yan lag tshang ba dang ldan pas snyoms par zhugs pas/ skad cig ma dang po la sems snang ba dga' ba'i ye shes/ gnyis pa la snang ba mched pa mchog dga'i ye shes/ gsum pa la snang ba nye bar thob pa dga' ba'i ye shes/ bzhi pa 'od gsal ba lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyams su myong bar byas nas/ re zhig mnyam par gzhag go /de nas rjes su chags pa'i bde ba chen pos phyi dang nang gi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ta badz+ra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod du gzhug go /de nas slob ma thugs rnam par dag pa mi bskyod pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsgom du bcug la/ rig mas spyi bor lag pa bzhag nas/ 'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi// khams gsum na ni sdig med de// de bas 'dod la chags bral bar// khyod kyis nam yang ma yin no// de ring phan chad bu khyed kyis// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// rmi lam ji bzhin sems can gyi// bla na med pa'i don byos shig /bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa yi// 'di ni man ngag las ni shes// rig pa 'di ni dor byas na// thabs gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya// brtul zhugs rnams kyi mchog gi mchog /rig ma'i brtul zhugs bu yis spyod// de ltar 'di ni rnal 'byor mchog /rdo rje rnal 'byor rnal 'byor mchog /rim pa ji bzhin yongs shes bya// rdo rje sems dpa'i go 'phang brtan// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ slob mas kyang*/ bka' bzhin du bgyi'o zhes brjod par bya'o// de nas gdong g.yogs pa phye la/ byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pas yid kyi dri ma dag par byas nas/ bde ba chen po'i lam bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ chos kyi sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so zhes brda sprad nas/ phyi'i mngon par byang chub pa dang*/ nang gi mngon par byang chub pa dang*/

rnal 'byor gnyis las byung ba don dam pa'i bden pa la slob tu gzhug go /dbang gi tshul gnyis po 'di slob ma rnal 'byor yongs su 'byongs pa la/ ji skad bshad pa'i tshul gyis dngos kyi phyag rgya la brten nas sbyin par bya'o// rnal 'byor ma 'byongs pa dang*/ rgan po dang*/ byis pa dang*/ ma ning la sogs pa rnams la ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyin par bya'o// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*// //de nas dbang bzhi pa'i don du slob ma mi bskyod pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pas/ bla ma sku gsum dbyer mi phyed pa'i rang bzhin du dmigs pa la/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar la/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can// srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyang ba// de ring tshig gi rin chen gyis// gtso bo bdag la bka' drin skyobs// khyod zhabs pad+mo spangs nas ni// gtso bo gzhan la skyabs ma mchis// 'gro ba'i dpa' bo thub chen gyis// bdag la nges par dbang skur cig /ces lan gsum du gsol ba btab pas sngar bzhin du slob ma'i gdong g.yogs te/ bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs kyis gnas su bcug la/ gsum pa'i dus su myong ba'i bzhi pa'i ye shes 'od gsal gyi rjes la 'byung ba'i zung du 'jug pa'i ye shes kyis zung 'jug gi rang bzhin mtshon pa'i phyir/ slob dpon gis tshig gis ngo sprad par bya ste/ dngos po thams cad dang bral ba/ phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs// chos bdag med pas mnyam pa nyid// rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// zhes brjod nas don bshad de/ 'dzin pa med pa'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog tu bcug nas/ so so rang gis rig pa'i ye shes tshul bzhin du skyes pa'i mthar/ sku gsung thugs dbyer mi phyed pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin du gyur pa sgom du gzhug go /de nas gdong g.yogs pa phye la/

don dam pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob pas/ dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag par byas nas/ zung du 'jug pa'i lam bsgom pa la dbang zhing*/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku mngon du byed pa'i skal ba dang ldan par byas so zhes brda sprad nas/ zung du 'jug pa'i rim pa la slob tu gzhug go /dbang bzhi pa'o// dngos gzhi'i cho ga'o// //dam tshig bsdus te khas blang dang*// yon 'bul ba gnyis slob ma'i las// dkyil 'khor mchod dang dngos grub blang*// bzod par gsol dang lhag chad bskang*// smon lam gdab dang gshegs su gsol// dkyil 'khor bsdu zhing phur bu dbyung*// bdag nyid yongs su bsrung ba ste// rjes kyi bya ba rnam pa bcu// de la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyis gang ji skad gsungs pa thams cad bsgrub pa'i bsam pas/ snga ma bzhin du lan gsum du dam bca'o// de nas rdo rje phreng ba las/ bdag la dngos grub mchog stsal lags// ting 'dzin kun gyi 'bras bu'ang stsal// sems can kun la ci 'dod par// dngos grub bla na med pa stsal// zhes tshig gi gtang rag phul nas/ dngos su ci 'byor pa'i yon dang*/ yid kyis kyang lus dang longs spyod dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad gong du brjod pa'i tshig lan gsum brjod pas dbul bar bya'o// de nas bla mas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la/ phyi dang gsang ba dang*/ yid las byung ba'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad nye bar gnang bar gsol ba btab la/ chad pa'am ni lhag pa'i tshig /bdag gis brjod dang gang bgyis pa// gang phyir lus can skyabs mdzad pa// mgon po khyod kyis bzod par gsol// ma rnyed pa dang ma shes pa// ma nus pa yang bzod par mdzod// ma tshang ba'am 'gal bgyis pa// de kun bzod pa mdzad par rigs// zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ nongs pa spyad pa bzod par gsol nas lhag chad kyi nyes pa bskang ba'i phyir/

zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba'am/ ma 'grub na yi ge brgya pa yang nas yang du brjod par bya'o// de nas las bsags pa 'bras bu dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ sems can thams cad bder gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par// gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba'i// des ni sangs rgyas nyid thob shog /ces bya ba la sogs pa shin tu rgya che ba'i smon lam gdab par bya'o// de nas spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa la dmigs te/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzod// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// zhes pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes brjod nas/ ye shes pa gshegs su gsol la/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdus nas/ a kā ro'i mthar/ oṃ gi li gi li hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ zhes brjod cing g.yas pa'i srin lag gis dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa bshig la/ rdul tshon ma lus par bsdus la rin po che'i snod du bzhugs nas/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bo chen por dor bar bya'o// de nas phyogs bcur btab pa'i rdo rje phur bu rnams mchod nas/ g.yon brkyang pa yi stabs kyis gnas// skam pa'i phyag rgyas phyogs bcu ru// gnas pa yi ni phur bu dag /gsang sngags brjod cing dbyung bar bya// oṃ badz+ra kī la/ ut+kī la ya sarba bigh+nān badz+ra dha ra ādz+nyā pa ya ti hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa ho// zhes gsungs pa ltar phyung nas/ rin po che'i snod du bzhag pa la dri'i chus gtor zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ satwa ar+thaṃ/ a mu ka s+ya shān+tiṃ ku ru swasti swā hā/ zhes brjod nas/ phur bu'i ye shes pa rnams gshegs su gsol la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gnas thams cad ba byung gis legs par byugs nas/ rjes mi mngon par bya'o// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ gnod mdzes kyi sngags brjod cing yi ge gsum gyis gnas gsum mngon par bsrungs nas dga' ston chen po la longs spyod cing ji ltar bde bar gnas par bya'o// de dag gis ni dbang gi bya ba yongs su rdzogs te/

thog mar smin par byed pa rgyu'i dbang ngo*// de nas bla mas dam tshig dang sdom pa rgyas par sbyin zhing*/ slob mas de la bslabs pas dbang gi dam tshig dang ye shes mi nyams par byas shing*/ rim pa gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa bstan pa la bslabs pas/ dbang gi don goms shing rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar byed pa ni grol bar byed pa'i lam yin la/ de nyid dbang gi don nyams su len pa'i phyir lam gyi dbang yin no// goms pa mthar son pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'dus te gshegs nas/ dbang bskur ba mdzad pa'i tshe phyi dang nang gi mngon par byang chub pa'i rim pa yongs su rdzogs nas/ rnam par thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa 'di ni 'bras bu'i dbang yin te/ dbang gsum gyis rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu'i chos ma lus pa yongs su bsdus pa yin no// //zab cing rgya che rnam par bkod legs 'dus pa'i rgya mtshor rgyud sde'i klung*// bye ba phrag brgya kun nas 'dus pa shin tu gzhal bar dka' ba'i klong*// klu sgrub klu yi dbang pos dbang mdzad des bkod bstan bcos rin chen gling*// man ngag nor bus cher bkra las 'ongs dbang rab gsal ba bdag gis gleng*// 'di 'dra'i tshul la tshul bzhin rab 'dun rnam dpyod blo yi dbyig ldan pa// rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal zhes bya bas yang nas yang du rab bskul bas// bdag gis sbyar mod tshu rol mthong ba byis pa'i blo yi ngang tshul bas// 'di la 'gal gang de la de ltar gzigs pa rnams kyis bzod par dgongs// dge ba gang zhig nye bar bskrun pas ma lus 'gro ba'ang dbang 'di yis// gang dag ji bzhin smin bar byas nas kun nas dge ba'i rim gnyis kyi// rnal 'byor mchog gis tshogs gnyis dpal rab rab tu rdzogs nas srid zhi'i dpal// sku gnyis zung 'jug rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje 'chang dbang nyid gyur cig/

//dpal gsang ba 'dus pa mi bskyod rdo rje lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i tshul/ slob dpon bdag nyid chen po mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje can/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal snga nas 'ongs pa/ grub pa brnyes pa'i slob dpon klu'i byang chub dang*/ slob dpon grag can 'dzin dpal bshes gnyen gyis gsal bar mdzad pa'i cho ga dang mthun par/ kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī bha dra'i zhal snga nas/ chos kyi rje mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po nyid kyis nos pa las thob cing*/ thob pa bzhin du gsal bar byas la/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ 'gro ba'i bla ma de nyid kyi zhabs kyi pad+ma la gus pas gtugs pa/ blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya bas/ chu pho khyi'i lo/ smal po'i zla ba la/ rgyal po'i pho brang kha'i phing hur zhes bya bar sbyar ba 'di yongs su rdzogs so// //gsang ba 'dus pa 'phags skor gyi dbang gi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang dbang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ rgya mtsho klu'i dbang po/ klu las byung ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ rgyal po bi su kalpa/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ ār+ya de wa/ klu'i byang chub/ zla ba grags pa/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ skal ldan grags pa/ 'od zer 'byung gnas grags pa/ pra bha ka ra de wa/ dharmā ka ra shān+ti/ bik+ṣa ta de wa/ kha che paṇa chen/ bla ma chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i bar du'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
